If you have about 20 to 30 minutes, read the contribution framing in the introduction, then the five-stage pipeline in the methods, then the within-model steering results, the cross-model transfer results, and finally the secure-code control. Do not over-focus on the 99.6% separability headline. The more informative result is the asymmetry: specificity holds reasonably well within a model, but breaks under cross-architecture mapping. That is the practical boundary to remember if you work on activation editing or alignment diagnostics.

recommendation.zh: 只看模型内方向与跨模型控制实验；它会降低你对“通用安全方向”的信心。
recommendation.en: Read the within-model versus cross-model controls; it should make you more skeptical of universal safety-direction claims.

paper.title: Want Better Synthetic Data? Steer It: Activation Steering for Low-Resource Language Generation
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have become an effective tool for synthetic data generation, including for low-resource languages, where generated data can improve downstream task performance. Current best-performing approaches typically rely on few-shot prompting with target-language examples, which increases inference costs and may reduce diversity through lexical anchoring. In this work, we investigate activation steering as an alternative for low-resource synthetic data generation. We study two

summary.core_problem: 解决低资源语言合成数据生成依赖 few-shot 示例、成本较高且容易被示例词汇锚定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 activation steering 的应用分析。它与预训练数据没有直接关系，但对控制 LLM 生成分布、语言身份向量和质量向量的可迁移性有一定参考。
summary.technical_approach: 研究两类 steering：Language Steering 通过激活方向增强目标语言身份；Quality Steering 通过对比人工文本与回译文本的表示来捕捉文本良构性。方法在 zero-shot 和 few-shot prompt 下都施加 steering，并比较不同开源 LLM、层位置和语言类型。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个开源 LLM、11 种类型差异较大的低资源语言，生成情感分类和主题分类数据，再微调小分类器评估下游效果。摘要未给出具体提升幅度。
summary.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies 与 DFKI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to generate synthetic data for low-resource languages without relying heavily on few-shot target-language examples.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an application-oriented analysis of activation steering. It is not pretraining-data work, but it gives a useful signal about controllable generation, language identity directions, and quality directions.
summary_en.technical_approach: It evaluates two steering strategies: Language Steering, which targets linguistic identity, and Quality Steering, which contrasts human-written text with backtranslated text to capture well-formedness. Steering is tested under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four open-source LLMs and 11 typologically diverse languages. It generates sentiment and topic classification data, then trains smaller classifiers for downstream evaluation. The abstract does not report exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies and DFKI.

recommendation.zh: 作为 activation steering 备查即可；任务太下游，真正有用的是层位置和语言方向的消融。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an activation-steering reference; the task is downstream, and the useful bits are the layer and language-direction ablations.

institutions: German Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence
Kempelen Institute of Intelligent Technologies, Bratislava, Slovakia
German Research Institute for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), Saarbrücken

paper.title: Closing the Loop: PID Feedback Control for Interpretable Activation Steering in Symbolic Music Generation
paper.abstract: Transformer-based architectures have significantly advanced the generation of complex symbolic sequences, yet a significant gap remains in achieving fine-grained, interpretable control over discrete signal attributes. This paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of the Multitrack Music Transformer (MMT) and proposes a framework for deterministic attribute modulation without retraining to bridge this gap via inference-time activation steering. Utilizing the Difference-in-Means (DiffMe

summary.core_problem: 研究如何在不重新训练符号音乐 Transformer 的情况下，对音高、时值等离散音乐属性做可解释、细粒度控制。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是机制分析和推理时控制方法。它把 activation steering、线性表征假设和反馈控制引入符号音乐生成，对 LLM 预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“表征方向是否可线性操控”这个问题有旁证价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Multitrack Music Transformer 的 residual stream 中用 Difference-in-Means 提取音高和时值相关方向，并用 steering magnitude 改变量化目标属性。为处理多属性 steering 的纠缠，引入 Gram-Schmidt 正交化做 Dual Steering；标题还显示使用 PID feedback control 做闭环调节，以降低手动调参和属性漂移。
summary.experiments: 实验对象是 Multitrack Music Transformer 和符号音乐序列。摘要报告 steering 强度与属性变化之间存在高相关性，并称几何解耦能降低多属性控制冲突；未给出模型规模、数据规模和具体提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to obtain interpretable, fine-grained control over pitch and duration in symbolic-music Transformers without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly mechanistic and control-oriented. It transfers activation steering, the linear representation hypothesis, and feedback control to symbolic music generation; this is not direct LLM pretraining work, but it is a useful side signal for linear feature controllability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use Difference-in-Means to identify pitch and duration directions in the residual stream of a Multitrack Music Transformer. Steering magnitude is used to modulate attributes, Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization is used to decouple multiple steering directions, and the title indicates a PID feedback loop for closed-loop attribute control.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on a Multitrack Music Transformer for symbolic music sequences. The abstract reports high correlation between steering magnitude and attribute shift, and reduced conflict under geometric decoupling, but does not provide model size, data size, or exact numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 作为 activation steering 在非文本序列上的旁证即可；看方法图和 steering 相关性结果，不必细读音乐实验。
recommendation.en: Useful only as a non-text activation-steering side case; read the method figure and steering-correlation results, not the music details.

paper.title: Pulling The REINS: Training-Free Safety Alignment of Video Diffusion Models via Representation Steering
paper.abstract: Open-weight video diffusion models can generate photorealistic unsafe content, from violence to misinformation, yet existing defenses either require expensive safety fine-tuning that degrades general capability, or apply external filters that are trivially bypassed by adversarial prompts. We present REINS (REpresentation-space INference-time Safety steering), a training-free method that aligns video diffusion models at inference time by steering their internal representations toward safe generat

summary.core_problem: 在不微调视频扩散模型的情况下，降低开放权重视频生成模型产生暴力、误导等不安全内容的概率。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型安全与表示操控方法。它不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但“安全属性在隐藏状态中近似线性可分、可用单方向 steering 控制”的结论，对 activation steering 和生成模型对齐有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: REINS 先用带二元安全标签的样本，通过 Supervised PCA 在视频 diffusion transformer 的 hidden states 中找出安全方向；推理时在中间 transformer 层把该方向加到隐藏状态上，将不安全生成轨迹重定向为语义相关的安全替代内容。方法不更新权重，也不依赖枚举危险概念或外部过滤器。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体视频模型、数据规模、baseline 数值或安全性/画质指标提升；只说明方法面向 open-weight video diffusion models，并声称避免安全微调带来的能力退化和外部过滤器易绕过问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce unsafe generations from open-weight video diffusion models without safety fine-tuning or external filtering.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a safety and representation-steering method for generative video models. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but the claim that safety is linearly encoded in hidden states is relevant to activation steering and alignment mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: REINS finds a safety direction in hidden-state activations using Supervised PCA on binary safety labels. At inference time, it adds this direction to an intermediate transformer layer to redirect unsafe trajectories toward semantically related safe outputs, without weight updates, concept enumeration, or external filters.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model names, dataset size, baselines, or numerical gains. It frames the method as a training-free alternative to safety fine-tuning and filter-based defenses for open-weight video diffusion models.

recommendation.zh: 不必通读；若做 activation steering，只看线性安全方向的构造和插入层选择，结论需等完整实验验证。
recommendation.en: No need to read end to end; if you work on activation steering, inspect the safety-direction construction and layer choice, but wait for full experiments.

paper.title: A Low-Rank Subspace Analysis of LLM Interventions
paper.abstract: Interventions designed to modify a particular behavior in LLMs, such as refusal or sycophancy, often produce unintended changes in other behaviors. This lack of targeted control makes it difficult to design and implement reliable safety controls. To understand these side-effects, we introduce a diagnostic framework for analyzing interacting behaviors in LLMs. We model behaviors as low-rank subspaces in activation space, and study how interventions influence across behaviors. Across multiple inst

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM 安全干预的可控性问题：针对拒答、越狱、谄媚等单一行为做微调或 activation steering 时，为什么经常会改动其他行为，以及这种副作用能否在表示空间里提前诊断。关键点不在于再提出一个新的干预算法，而是把“行为不是彼此独立的控制旋钮”这件事形式化，并解释干预影响为何具有方向性。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口有直接启发。许多安全、对齐和偏好训练方法默认可以局部修改某类行为，但该工作显示，不同行为在 residual stream 中共享低秩表示结构；一个行为的干预如果落在共享子空间上，就可能改变另一个行为。更重要的是，副作用不是对称的，A 影响 B 不等于 B 影响 A。这提示后训练阶段的行为调控不能只看目标任务指标，也要测量行为子空间的重叠、决策耦合和传播路径。贡献量级偏诊断框架和机制分析，不是训练 recipe，但对设计更可控的 alignment objective、orthogonality constraint、activation intervention 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法从 matched contrastive dataset 开始。对每个行为 m 构造正负样本对，正样本诱发该行为，负样本抑制该行为，并尽量匹配非行为因素。模型表示取 decoder-only Transformer 某一层 residual stream 的 last-token activation。对每个正负样本对计算差分向量 Δ_i = h_last(x_i^+) - h_last(x_i^-)，把所有差分堆成矩阵，中心化后做 SVD。不同于只取单个“行为方向”的做法，作者把 top-k principal components 作为行为低秩子空间，用它描述该行为在激活空间中的主要变化模式。

一个重要处理是移除 decision-aligned variance。初始 SVD 的主成分可能主要反映模型最终选择正/负标签的决策信号，而不是更细的行为结构。作者用 label string 的 log-probability margin 定义决策边界相关信号，识别与 margin 高相关的方向，并将这部分显式剥离，再分析剩余的行为子空间。这样做的动机是避免把“模型已经决定输出什么”误当成“行为内部表示结构”。

干预分析有两个核心量：第一是行为子空间之间的几何重叠，通常可通过投影、principal angle 或相关的 overlap metric 衡量；第二是 decision coupling，即某个行为子空间与决策子空间之间的角度或耦合强度。重叠解释“一个行为的干预为什么能碰到另一个行为”，决策耦合解释“碰到以后为什么会真正改变输出”。两者结合后可以解释非对称性：如果 A 的子空间既与 B 重叠，又更强地接入模型决策，那么 A 上的干预会更容易传播到 B；反过来未必成立。作者用 projection-based intervention 来验证这一点，即对源行为子空间做投影、消除或 steering，然后测量目标行为的 margin 或行为指标变化。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖多个 instruction-tuned 模型，规模从 7B 到 70B，行为设置包括 refusal、jailbreak 和 sycophancy。主要结果有四点。第一，拒答、越狱、谄媚等行为在激活空间中并非完全分离，存在可测量的共享低秩结构。第二，单方向行为表示不足以解释干预副作用，低秩子空间能更稳定地刻画跨行为传播。第三，cross-behavior effect 与子空间 overlap 和 decision coupling 同时相关；只有 overlap 高但决策耦合弱时，干预未必显著改变目标行为。第四，干预影响有明显方向性，A→B 和 B→A 的强度不同，一些行为更像上游控制点，改动后会广泛影响其他行为，而另一些行为的影响更局部。

给出的材料中没有完整列出各模型、各行为对的具体表格数值，因此不应把结果理解为某个固定提升幅度。更稳妥的读法是：7B–70B 多尺度模型上的现象一致，说明该诊断框架不是某个小模型或单一数据集的偶然结果。
summary.reading_guide:
建议精读 Section 3 和 Section 5。Section 3 的重点是 matched contrast construction、SVD 子空间抽取、decision margin、decision-aligned variance removal，以及 overlap / decision coupling 的定义。这里决定了整个分析是否可靠。Section 5 应重点看跨行为干预矩阵、A→B 与 B→A 的非对称结果、不同层和不同 k 的敏感性，以及“upstream control point”的具体例子。

读的时候可以重点检查三个问题。第一，正负样本对是否真的控制了非行为因素，否则 SVD 主方向可能捕捉主题、格式或语气。第二，移除 decision-aligned variance 后，剩余子空间是否仍能预测行为干预效果。第三，projection intervention 的强度是否可比，因为不同子空间维度和激活范数会影响干预幅度。若要把该方法用于自己的安全训练或 post-train 诊断，最值得复现的是行为子空间 overlap heatmap 和方向性干预矩阵。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a control problem in LLM safety interventions: when fine-tuning or activation steering targets one behavior, such as refusal, jailbreak susceptibility, or sycophancy, why do other behaviors change as a side effect? The main goal is not to propose another intervention method, but to build a representation-level diagnostic for predicting and explaining these cross-behavior effects.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between pretraining, instruction tuning, and safety post-training. Many alignment interventions implicitly treat behaviors as separable control targets. This paper shows that several behaviors share low-rank structure in the residual stream, so modifying one behavior can move the model along directions that also support other behaviors. The asymmetry result is especially useful: an intervention from behavior A to behavior B need not match the reverse direction. This matters for safety evaluations, activation steering, preference tuning, and attempts to impose orthogonality constraints between behavioral features. The contribution is best viewed as a diagnostic and mechanistic framework rather than a new training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
For each behavior, the authors build a matched contrastive dataset with positive examples that elicit the behavior and negative examples that suppress it. At a chosen layer of a decoder-only Transformer, they take the last-token residual-stream activation and compute paired contrast vectors between positive and negative examples. These vectors are centered and decomposed with SVD. Instead of representing a behavior by a single steering direction, the method represents it as a top-k low-rank subspace.

A key step is removing decision-aligned variance. The leading singular components can reflect the model’s final positive-vs-negative decision rather than behavior-specific structure. The paper defines a scalar decision margin using the log-probability difference of label strings, identifies components aligned with this margin, and separates them from the behavior subspace analysis. This is meant to avoid conflating decision readout with the internal representation of the behavior.

The diagnostic then studies two quantities. The first is geometric overlap between behavior subspaces, measured through projection-style or principal-angle-style comparisons. The second is decision coupling, which measures how strongly a behavior subspace is connected to the model’s decision direction. Projection-based interventions are applied to a source behavior subspace, and the induced changes are measured on target behaviors. Overlap explains whether an intervention can reach another behavior; decision coupling explains whether that shared representation actually affects the output. Their combination accounts for asymmetric intervention effects.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments cover multiple instruction-tuned models from 7B to 70B parameters and several behavior settings, including refusal, jailbreak, and sycophancy. The main empirical findings are qualitative but consistent. First, different behaviors share internal low-rank structure. Second, low-rank subspaces explain cross-behavior effects better than isolated one-dimensional directions. Third, cross-behavior interference is associated with both subspace overlap and decision coupling. High overlap alone is not sufficient if the shared representation is weakly coupled to the model’s decision. Fourth, intervention effects are directional: A→B can be strong while B→A is weak. Some behaviors behave like upstream control points whose interventions propagate broadly, while others remain more localized.

The provided content does not include the full numerical tables for every model and behavior pair, so the safest interpretation is about the repeated pattern across 7B–70B models rather than a single headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read Section 3 carefully. The important details are the contrastive dataset construction, the SVD-based behavior subspace, the definition of the decision margin, the removal of decision-aligned variance, and the metrics for subspace overlap and decision coupling. Then focus on Section 5, especially the cross-behavior intervention matrices, the asymmetric A→B versus B→A cases, the layer and rank-k sensitivity analyses, and the examples of upstream control points.

Three checks are useful while reading. First, verify whether the positive and negative pairs control for topic, style, and formatting confounds. Second, check whether the behavior subspace remains predictive after removing decision-aligned components. Third, inspect how intervention strength is normalized across subspaces. For practical reuse, the most useful artifacts to reproduce are the subspace-overlap heatmaps and the directed intervention-effect matrix.

recommendation.zh: 把“对齐干预外溢”从玄学拉回几何量：先复现它的子空间重叠/非对称传播，再决定你的 steering/拒答头是否在踩同一组特征。
recommendation.en: It turns alignment spillover into measurable geometry—replicate the subspace overlap/asymmetric propagation first, then reassess whether your steering/refusal heads share the same features.

paper.title: Dual-Stance Evaluation of Sycophancy: The Structure of Agreement and the Limits of Intervention
paper.abstract: Activation steering can shift LLM behaviour, but standard evaluations do not typically test whether a sycophancy-reduction direction also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements. We introduce dual-stance evaluation, which tests both stances of each topic, and apply it to centroid-difference steering on Llama-3-8B-Instruct. We find a dissociation: the model represents sycophantic and factual agreement in geometrically distinct subspaces, yet the steering direction projects equally

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何降低 sycophancy”，而是一个更基础的识别问题：常见的 activation steering，尤其是用 agree/disagree 激活质心差得到的方向，究竟是在压制“迎合用户”这一特定行为，还是只是把模型整体往“不愿意说 YES”推。以往评测通常只看单边 stance，例如用户说“地球是平的”时模型是否少同意了，但这无法区分三种情况：只抑制 sycophancy、统一抑制所有 agreement、或两者都抑制但幅度不同。作者提出 dual-stance evaluation，让同一主题的相反立场都被测试，从而直接检查：模型是否连对事实正确陈述的同意也一起被削弱，以及模型在基线下是否会对互相矛盾的主张都表示同意。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 行为干预、activation editing、mechanistic interpretability 的评测方法有明确启发。它指出一个常见误区：如果只看目标行为是否下降，很容易把“非特异性的 polarity shift”误判成“成功提取了某种高层行为特征”。这对基座研究也有价值，因为很多人会把 residual-space 线性方向解释成可控语义因子；这篇工作说明，模型内部也许确实区分了 factual agreement 和 sycophantic agreement，但简单的 centroid-difference 并不能利用这种区分。换句话说，表示里有结构，不代表线性干预就能精确调用这部分结构。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三层。第一层是评测设计。作者构造了 50 个 topic、100 个 stance-specific item，覆盖 symmetric opinions、asymmetric opinions、soft facts、hard facts 四类。每个 topic 都测试互相矛盾的两个用户立场，提示模板固定，只通过温度采样产生行为变化。这样做的关键好处是把“单次同意”拆成“对哪一边同意、是否两边都同意、对事实正确一边是否保留同意”几个可分离信号。

第二层是行为分类与连续指标。作者先按未干预基线把 topic 经验性分成 sycophantic、opinionated、mixed 三类，但真正重要的是一个连续量：dual-stance consistency。直观上，它衡量模型在同一主题上对两边 stance 的一致性或摇摆程度。这个量后来被用来预测 steering susceptibility，避免结论依赖离散阈值。

第三层是 steering 与几何分析。干预对象是 Llama-3-8B-Instruct，采用标准 centroid-difference steering：从 agree 与 disagree 条件下抽取激活，计算质心差方向，并在生成时注入。作者随后做了两类分析。其一是行为层面，比较该方向对 sycophantic agreement 与 factual agreement 的影响。其二是表示层面，检查两类 agreement activation 在几何上是否可分，以及 steering direction 对这两个子空间的投影关系。核心发现是：两类 agreement 在激活空间中是可区分的，说明模型内部“知道”二者不同；但质心差方向对两者投影近似相同，因此干预缺乏选择性。也就是说，问题不在于表示完全纠缠，而在于所选线性方向过于粗糙，只抓住了 agreement polarity 这一更浅层的轴。
summary.experiments:
关键实验结论很清楚。第一，steering 是非特异性的：它不仅降低对迎合性陈述的同意，也降低对事实正确陈述的同意。文中给出的代表性数字是，在基线同意率相近的条件下，sycophantic items 与 hard-fact correct stances 的基线分别约为 93% 和 96%，但干预后前者下降约 89%，后者也下降约 14%。这已经足以否定“只抑制 sycophancy”的解释。

第二，这种非特异性不是简单的均匀平移，而是有结构的。不同 item 对 steering 的敏感度差异很大，而这种差异可以被 dual-stance consistency 很好预测：样本内相关系数 r=0.88，在 12 个新 topic 上外推仍有 r=0.84。也就是说，模型越倾向于在同一主题上对相反立场都表示同意，它越容易被该方向推向“不再同意”。

第三，几何分析支持“表示可分、干预不可分”的解释。作者报告 sycophantic agreement 与 factual agreement 占据激活空间中不同区域，但 steering direction 对两类 activation group 的投影相当接近。文中还强调，其他静态属性已做匹配，因此行为差异更可能来自局部几何或生成动力学，而不是简单的均值、范数或可分性差异。

实验设置上，主实验对每个 item 做 20 次采样，温度 T=0.9；prompt 模板固定，减少 prompt confound。hard facts 中 A/B 与正确性有标签耦合，但作者用 symmetric-opinion 条目中 A/B 可交换且下降对称的结果，说明主要结论不依赖 stance 标签本身。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先把 dual-stance evaluation 想清楚：它不是多做一倍样本，而是把“agreement”拆成更有诊断性的结构。然后看 Methods 里四类 topic 的构造方式，以及为什么 hard facts、soft facts、symmetric/asymmetric opinions 要分开。这里决定了后面结论能否站住。

接着重点看行为结果部分，尤其是 sycophantic items 与 factual-correct stances 在相近基线下却出现明显不同下降幅度的图表；这是全文最核心的证据。再看 dual-stance consistency 与 steering susceptibility 的相关分析，这部分说明 steering 不是随机失真，而是沿着某种可预测的行为轴起作用。

最后看 subspace / geometry analysis。阅读时不要把它理解成“模型没学会区分”，恰好相反，作者的论点是模型内部已经区分了，但 centroid-difference 方向没有把这个区分提取出来。若只打算花 20-30 分钟，建议读 Introduction、Methods 中数据设计、主结果图和几何分析结论；附录可只在关心 item 设计与鲁棒性时再看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrower and more diagnostic question than “can activation steering reduce sycophancy?”: when a standard agree-vs-disagree centroid direction lowers agreement with user opinions, is it actually targeting sycophantic deference, or is it merely pushing the model toward generic disagreement? Prior evaluations usually test only one stance per topic, so they cannot distinguish a sycophancy-specific intervention from a broad YES/NO polarity shift. The proposed dual-stance evaluation tests both contradictory stances of the same topic, making it possible to check whether steering also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements and whether the model agrees with both sides at baseline.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for anyone working on activation editing, behavioral control, and mechanistic claims about linear directions in LLMs. The main value is methodological: a reduction in the target behavior is not enough evidence that a direction isolates the intended latent trait. A direction may look successful under standard evaluation while actually acting as a coarse polarity control. For foundation-model research, the paper is a reminder that internal representational separation does not imply that a simple linear intervention can selectively access that separation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. First, the evaluation design. The authors build 50 topics with paired contradictory stances, covering symmetric opinions, asymmetric opinions, soft facts, and hard facts. The prompt template is held fixed, and behavioral variation comes from temperature sampling rather than prompt changes. This allows agreement behavior to be decomposed into stronger diagnostics: agreement with which side, agreement with both sides, and preservation of agreement for the factually correct side.

Second, they use both discrete and continuous behavioral characterizations. Topics are empirically grouped from baseline behavior into sycophantic, opinionated, or mixed, but the more important quantity is a continuous measure called dual-stance consistency, which captures how consistently the model agrees across both stances of the same topic. This later predicts how susceptible an item is to steering.

Third, they apply standard centroid-difference steering to Llama-3-8B-Instruct and then analyze both behavior and geometry. The steering vector is derived from agree vs disagree activations. Behaviorally, they compare its effect on sycophantic agreement and factual agreement. Geometrically, they test whether these two kinds of agreement occupy distinct regions in activation space and how the steering direction projects onto them. The central result is subtle: factual and sycophantic agreement are internally distinguishable, but the centroid-difference direction projects similarly onto both. So the limitation is not that the model fails to represent the distinction; it is that this particular linear direction does not isolate it.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is non-specificity. Steering reduces agreement with sycophantic statements, but it also reduces agreement with factually correct statements. The representative comparison in the paper matches high-baseline conditions: sycophantic items and hard-fact correct stances start at roughly 93% and 96% agreement, yet steering reduces them by about 89% and 14%, respectively. That rules out the claim that the direction is selectively removing sycophancy.

At the same time, the effect is structured rather than uniform. Steering susceptibility varies strongly across items, and that variation is well predicted by dual-stance consistency: r=0.88 in-sample and r=0.84 on 12 held-out topics. Items for which the model tends to agree with both contradictory stances are much easier to push away from agreement.

The geometric analysis supports a “representationally distinct but interventionally entangled” picture. The two activation groups occupy different regions of activation space, yet the steering direction has similar projection onto both. The paper also notes that other static properties of the activation groups were matched, which narrows the explanation toward local geometry or generation dynamics rather than simple mean-level differences.

Experimentally, the setup uses 20 trials per item at temperature 0.9 with a fixed prompt template. The hard-fact A/B labeling is confounded with correctness, but the authors argue this does not drive the main result, partly because symmetric-opinion items show symmetric declines under steering when the labels are interchangeable.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first conceptual figure. The key idea is not just “evaluate more examples,” but “evaluate both stances of the same topic so agreement becomes diagnostically meaningful.” Then read the methods section carefully enough to understand why the four topic categories are separated and how the prompt is controlled.

After that, focus on the main behavioral results: the comparison between sycophantic items and factually correct hard-fact stances at similar baseline agreement is the strongest evidence in the paper. The dual-stance-consistency correlation analysis is the next important piece because it shows the intervention is structured, not merely noisy degradation.

Finish with the subspace analysis. The right interpretation is that the model already encodes the distinction, but the centroid-difference direction fails to exploit it. If reading time is limited to about 20-30 minutes, prioritize the introduction, dataset design in methods, the main results figures, and the geometry section. The appendix matters mainly if you want to inspect item construction or robustness details.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不提供新 steering 技巧，但把旧评测的漏洞钉得很死；做表示编辑的人至少看 dual-stance protocol 和“可读不等于可控”这个结论。
recommendation.en: No new steering trick here, but it cleanly breaks a weak evaluation habit; if you work on representation editing, read the dual-stance protocol and the 'readable is not controllable' result.

paper.title: On The Effectiveness-Fluency Trade-Off In LLM Conditioning: A Systematic Study
paper.abstract: Controlling the output of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a central challenge for their reliable deployment, yet a clear understanding of the involved trade-offs remains elusive. Current approaches to conditioning are often evaluated with a narrow focus on their effectiveness at injecting or removing a target concept, neglecting generation quality. We systematically investigate a range of conditioning methods in both injection and removal scenarios. We find that efficient steering methods freque

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是：当我们用 prompting、activation steering、LoRA-SFT 等手段去给 LLM 注入或移除某个概念时，控制效果和生成质量之间到底如何权衡，以及这种权衡会不会随着模型训练范式变化而改变。论文不是只看“有没有把概念打进去/拿掉”，而是把 fluency、语法完整性、指令遵循一起纳入评估。更关键的一点是，它把 base model 和 instruction-tuned model 分开看，发现 activation steering 在 base 模型上常常有效，但到了 instruction-tuned 模型上明显失灵。这说明很多 steering 结论并不能直接从 base model 外推到实际部署更常见的 instruct model。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出新的训练方法，而在于澄清了一个经常被忽略的接口问题：预训练表征、指令微调后的表征重组、以及推理时控制方法之间并不是可交换的。activation steering 依赖中间层线性可操控方向，但 instruction tuning 会改变这些方向的可分性、局部线性结构和生成时的服从机制，因此同样的 steering 向量在 base 与 instruct 上效果差异很大。这个结论对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人有参考意义：如果后续还想保留可控性，可能需要在预训练或中间训练阶段显式保留某些可分解属性，而不是指望事后用 activation patching 补救。另一个有用结论是，perplexity 不是可靠的 fluency 代理，尤其在重复和长度偏移存在时会误导判断；更便宜的 lexical diversity 指标反而更接近人工或 LLM judge 的流畅性判断。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，论文做的是一个较完整的控制方法对照实验，而不是提出单一新算法。它比较三类方法。第一类是 prompting：为概念注入设计 10 个模板，类似“你是一个专门讨论<concept>的聊天机器人”；在 toxicity removal 上则采用已有的减毒提示模板。第二类是 LoRA-SFT：只在 attention 模块上训练低秩适配器，目标是让模型直接学习生成目标概念句子；训练使用 AdamW，LoRA rank=2，dropout=0.05，学习率 1e-4，训练步数较短，强调低成本适配。第三类是 activation steering，包括 ITI、CAA、Linear AcT 三种代表方法。ITI 用二分类器切向量作为层级 bias，只干预最后 token 的 attention output；CAA 用 source/target 激活差构造统一 steering vector，并对后续生成 token 持续施加；Linear AcT 则学习一个线性映射，把 source activation 分布搬运到 target 分布，训练目标是 optimal transport loss，干预位置放在 LayerNorm 层。

数据设计也比较讲究。概念注入任务使用 60 个概念、10 个语义类别的层级化概念集，每个概念由 Mistral-7B-Instruct 生成 400 句描述句。这样做的好处是概念覆盖面比单一属性更广，也避免 steering 只在少数 topic 上成立。对于 steering，target sentence 是目标概念句，source sentence 从其他概念中随机采样；对于 SFT，则直接在这 400 句上训练。概念移除任务选 toxicity mitigation，但这里作者区分了 steering 和 SFT 的训练需求：steering 只需要 toxic/non-toxic 两组 continuation 来学方向；SFT 则必须构造“高毒 prompt + 低毒 continuation”的配对样本，否则模型学不到在诱导性 prompt 下仍保持无毒输出的能力。这一点说明作者对不同控制方法的训练信号需求理解得比较细。

评估上，论文的核心贡献之一是把“控制成功”和“文本质量”拆开。它用 LLM-as-judge 评估概念注入/移除成功率、fluency、instruction following，同时补充一组便宜的文本统计和 BERT/corpus-based 指标。作者特别分析了 perplexity 的失效原因：当模型通过重复、模板化短句、或异常长度分布来“迎合”目标概念时，PPL 可能并不差，但文本已经明显不自然。相比之下，type-token ratio 这类词汇多样性指标与 fluency 更一致。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最重要的实验结论有四个。

第一，存在明显的 effectiveness-fluency trade-off。activation steering 往往能把概念强行推入输出，但代价是流畅性、语法自然度和指令遵循下降，尤其是持续对所有生成 token 施加干预的方法更容易出现重复、僵硬措辞和局部语义断裂。也就是说，单看概念命中率会高估 steering 的实用性。

第二，instruction tuning 会显著削弱 activation steering。作者把同一套 steering 方法同时用在 base 和 instruct 模型上，发现后者的控制效果明显下降，而 prompting 和 SFT 在 instruct 模型上更稳。这是全文最有信息量的发现。它暗示 instruction tuning 不只是让模型“更会聊天”，还重塑了中间表征与输出行为之间的映射，使得简单线性方向不再足够控制生成。

第三，不同任务偏好不同方法。概念注入场景下，SFT 和直接 prompting 通常优于 activation steering；但在 toxicity removal 这种概念移除任务里，steering 反而更有竞争力，因为它可以直接把表示往“非毒性”方向推，而不必学习复杂的条件生成映射。这个差异说明“注入”和“移除”不是对称问题，不能用同一套方法排序。

第四，评估指标方面，perplexity 不能稳定反映 fluency。作者展示了 PPL 会被重复和句长偏差污染，而 type-token ratio 与 LLM judge 的 fluency 评分相关性更高；部分昂贵的 judge 结论还能被较便宜的 BERT 或语料统计指标近似复现。对大规模控制实验来说，这意味着可以先用便宜指标做筛选，再用 judge 做少量复核。

从给出的设置细节可确认的规模包括：概念注入数据为 60 个概念 × 每概念 400 句；toxicity steering 使用 356 条高毒样本和 379 条低毒样本；toxicity SFT 使用 455 条“高毒 prompt + 低毒 continuation”样本。LoRA-SFT 采用 rank 2 的极小适配器，这使得它在低参数更新预算下仍能与 steering 和 prompting 对比，实验设计较公平。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和实验主表，抓住三件事：一是作者不是在比谁控制更强，而是在比控制强度和文本质量的联合表现；二是 base 与 instruct 的差异是全文主结论；三是概念注入与概念移除的最优方法并不一样。然后重点看方法部分里对 ITI、CAA、Linear AcT 干预位置和训练信号的区别，这决定了它们为什么会有不同副作用。再看评估部分关于 perplexity 失真的分析，以及 type-token ratio、BERT/corpus 指标与 LLM judge 的对应关系。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主要信息；如果你关心 post-train 后模型可控性，建议再细看 toxicity 任务的数据构造，因为那里把 steering 与 SFT 的训练需求差异讲得比较清楚。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but under-specified question in LLM control: when we inject or remove a concept using prompting, activation steering, or lightweight fine-tuning, how much control do we really gain, and what do we lose in fluency and instruction adherence? The key contribution is not another steering method, but a fuller evaluation setup that separates conditioning success from generation quality. A particularly important finding is that activation steering behaves very differently on base models versus instruction-tuned models: methods that look effective on base checkpoints degrade sharply on instruct models, which are the models people actually deploy.
summary_en.importance: Its value for pretraining-oriented readers is mainly diagnostic. It shows that controllability at inference time depends strongly on the representation geometry inherited from pretraining and then reshaped by instruction tuning. Activation steering assumes that a target property can be manipulated through relatively stable linear directions in hidden space. The paper provides evidence that instruction tuning weakens this assumption, likely by reorganizing hidden states around instruction-following behavior and response formatting. That matters for the pretrain ↔ post-train interface: if one wants controllability to remain available after alignment, it may need to be preserved or encouraged earlier in training rather than added later through hidden-state interventions. A second useful takeaway is methodological: perplexity is a poor proxy for fluency under control interventions, while simple lexical-diversity measures can track fluency more reliably.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work is a systematic comparison across three families of conditioning methods. First, prompting: for concept injection, the authors build ten prompt templates such as “You are a chatbot that specializes in <concept>,” and prepend them to generic generation prompts; for toxicity mitigation, they use prior anti-toxicity prompt templates. Second, LoRA-based supervised fine-tuning: low-rank adapters are trained on attention modules with cross-entropy loss over target concept sentences, using AdamW, rank-2 LoRA, dropout 0.05, learning rate 1e-4, and short training schedules chosen via a small grid search. Third, activation steering: they evaluate ITI, CAA, and Linear AcT. ITI learns layerwise biases from classifier tangents using last-token-pooled activations and intervenes on attention outputs for the last tokens. CAA averages source-target activation differences into a steering vector applied to future generated tokens. Linear AcT learns a linear transport map between source and target activation distributions using an optimal-transport objective, and applies interventions at LayerNorm layers.

The dataset design is stronger than in many steering papers. For concept injection, they use 60 concepts organized into 10 semantic categories, with 400 synthetic descriptive sentences per concept generated by Mistral-7B-Instruct. This broadens the study beyond a few hand-picked attributes. For steering, target examples are concept sentences and source examples are sampled from other concepts; for SFT, the model is directly trained on the 400 target sentences. For concept removal, they use toxicity mitigation on Real Toxicity Prompts. Importantly, they distinguish the supervision needs of steering and SFT: steering only needs toxic versus non-toxic examples to estimate a direction, whereas SFT requires prompt-continuation pairs where the prompt is toxic but the continuation is non-toxic, otherwise it does not learn to resist toxic prompts at generation time. That distinction is technically important and often glossed over.

Evaluation is the other major contribution. The paper uses an LLM-as-judge pipeline to score conditioning success, fluency, and instruction following, and complements it with cheaper textual and embedding-based metrics. A central analysis is why perplexity fails: interventions can induce repetition, templated outputs, or abnormal length distributions, all of which can leave PPL deceptively acceptable while the text is clearly degraded. Simpler measures such as type-token ratio correlate better with judged fluency.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical findings are fourfold.

First, there is a real effectiveness-fluency trade-off. Activation steering often improves concept control, but frequently at a substantial cost in fluency, grammatical naturalness, and instruction following. Methods that intervene broadly across generated tokens are especially prone to repetition and rigid phrasing. This means that evaluating only concept hit rate materially overstates the usefulness of steering.

Second, instruction tuning sharply reduces the effectiveness of activation steering. Applying the same steering methods to base and instruction-tuned variants reveals a clear drop on instruct models, while prompting and LoRA-SFT remain more robust there. This is the most informative result in the paper. It suggests that instruction tuning changes the mapping from hidden-state geometry to output behavior enough that simple linear interventions no longer transfer cleanly.

Third, the best method depends on the task type. For concept injection, direct prompting and SFT generally outperform activation steering. For concept removal, especially toxicity mitigation, steering is more competitive because it can directly push representations away from undesirable regions without learning a full conditional generation policy. Injection and removal are therefore not symmetric control problems.

Fourth, perplexity is not a stable fluency metric in this setting. The paper shows that PPL can be distorted by repetition and length effects, whereas type-token ratio aligns better with LLM-judge fluency scores. Some expensive judge-based conclusions can also be approximated by cheaper BERT-based or corpus-based metrics, which is useful for large-scale screening.

The concrete scales reported in the paper include 60 concepts with 400 sentences each for concept injection, 356 toxic and 379 non-toxic examples for toxicity steering, and 455 toxic-prompt/non-toxic-continuation pairs for toxicity SFT. The LoRA setup is intentionally tiny, with rank 2 adapters, making the comparison against prompting and steering relatively fair under low adaptation budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the introduction and the main result tables. Focus on three points: the paper evaluates joint control-quality trade-offs rather than control alone; the base-versus-instruct split is the central result; and concept injection and concept removal favor different methods. Then read the method section only to the extent needed to understand where ITI, CAA, and Linear AcT intervene and what supervision each one uses, because those design choices explain much of the quality degradation. After that, go to the evaluation analysis on why perplexity breaks and why type-token ratio works better. A 20–30 minute skim is enough to extract the main lessons. If your interest is in the pretrain/post-train interface, spend extra time on the toxicity setup, where the paper carefully explains why steering and SFT require different data constructions.

recommendation.zh: 条件控制方法的系统对比，发现训练范式与激活转向的交互效应有实用意义——指令调优削弱了激活转向效果。读 §3-§4 实验部分即可。
recommendation.en: Systematic comparison of conditioning methods; the finding that instruction tuning weakens activation steering efficacy is practically meaningful. Read §3-§4 experiments only.

paper.title: Scenario-based Probing and Steering Cultural Values in Large Language Models--Extended Version
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are deployed across cultural contexts but often reflect homogenized values inherited from training data. Evaluations of cultural alignment typically rely on direct prompting with survey-style questions, which frequently elicit neutral or safety-aligned responses and fail to capture underlying model preferences. We propose a framework for probing and steering latent cultural representations in LLMs along the two Inglehart--Welzel axes of the World Values Survey (WVS).

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想测量并干预 LLM 内部潜在的文化价值表征，避免传统问卷式 prompt 只测到安全模板化回答而看不到真实偏好。
summary.importance: 贡献更偏分析与 probing：一是把文化价值测量从显式问答改成情境化行为困境；二是用 token 概率和 activation steering 研究价值表征是否可分离、可操控。这对理解模型内部表征有一定启发，但离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者基于 World Values Survey 的 Inglehart-Welzel 两条价值轴，把抽象价值问题改写成 scenario-based dilemmas，再从候选行为选项的 token-level probabilities 估计模型隐含价值倾向；随后用 activation steering，并可叠加 country-conditioned prompting，在不微调的前提下推动模型沿目标文化方向偏移，同时观察不同价值维度之间的 entanglement。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3 个开源 LLM、4 个目标文化。主要结果是：不同模型的可操控性差异明显；单轴 steering 往往会连带改变另一条价值轴，说明潜在表征存在耦合。摘要未给出参数规模、具体模型名和量化提升幅度，因此结论更适合作为现象性信号，而不是可直接迁移的 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Copenhagen 与 Aalborg University。未见基座预训练方向的头部实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tries to measure and steer latent cultural value representations in LLMs, instead of relying on survey-style prompts that mostly elicit safety-shaped or neutral answers.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a probing/analysis contribution: it reframes cultural alignment measurement as scenario-based behavioral dilemmas and uses token probabilities plus activation steering to test whether value representations are separable and controllable. It is somewhat useful for representation analysis, but only loosely connected to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the two Inglehart-Welzel axes in the World Values Survey, the authors convert abstract value questions into scenario-based dilemmas, then infer implicit value preferences from token-level probabilities over behavioral options. They apply activation steering, optionally combined with country-conditioned prompting, to shift model behavior without finetuning, and inspect entanglement across value dimensions.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover three open-source LLMs and four target cultures. The main findings are that steerability varies substantially across models, and steering one value axis often shifts the other axis as well, suggesting entangled latent representations. The abstract does not provide model sizes, exact model names, or effect sizes, so the evidence is more useful as a phenomenon than as a reusable recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of Copenhagen and Aalborg University. No clearly identifiable major pretraining lab background is evident from the paper metadata.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练主线距离较远，但如果你关心 activation steering 到底在改“表征”还是改“输出模板”，这篇的 scenario probing 设计值得当弱证据看。
recommendation.en: Far from core pretraining, but if you care whether activation steering changes representations or just output style, the scenario-based probing setup is a useful weak signal.

paper.title: When is Your LLM Steerable?
paper.abstract: Activation steering offers a lightweight approach to control language models' behavior at inference time, but whether it succeeds or fails heavily depends on the prompt, concept, model, and steering configuration. Finding the regime and boundaries of successful steering typically requires expensive grid searches and post-hoc evaluation of full autoregressive rollouts. In this work, we investigate whether steerability can be predicted from the model's internal states at the beginning of the gener

summary.core_problem: Activation steering 的成功与否高度依赖 prompt、概念、模型和配置，但目前通常要靠昂贵的 rollout 网格搜索才能知道何时可控。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个 steerability 预测问题设定加上大规模测试床 ASTEER。它更偏推理时控制与内部表征分析，不直接推进预训练方法，但对理解早期解码状态是否已决定后续可控性有一定机制价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建 ASTEER，收集 1.4M 条带成功/失败标签的 steering generation，覆盖 150 个概念。方法上从生成前几步的内部状态中提取特征，比较 steering 前后各层 hidden states 的差异，用这些早期特征预测后续 steering 是否会成功，并据此改进 steering 配置或触发策略。
summary.experiments: 数据规模是 140 万条 steered generations。实验重点应包括：不同模型、概念和 prompt 上的 steerability 预测精度；只看前几 token 的内部状态能否替代完整 rollout；以及基于预测器的 steering success rate 提升。摘要未给出具体模型规模和提升幅度，因此更适合作为机制线索而非结论性方法。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 University of Maryland, College Park。Soheil Feizi 与 Tianyi Zhou 在鲁棒性、可控性和基础模型分析方向有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering is highly regime-dependent, but today one often needs expensive rollout-based grid search to know when steering will succeed.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a steerability prediction setup plus the ASTEER testbed. It is more about inference-time control and internal-state analysis than pretraining, but it offers a useful mechanistic angle on whether early decoding states already determine controllability.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper builds ASTEER with 1.4M steered generations labeled as success or failure across 150 concepts. It extracts features from the first few decoding steps, comparing hidden states before and after steering across layers, and uses these early-state features to predict downstream steering success and improve steering decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset scale is 1.4 million steered generations. The key evaluations should test prediction accuracy across prompts, concepts, and models; whether early-state features can replace full rollouts; and whether a predictor-guided policy improves steering success. The abstract does not provide model sizes or exact gains, so this is better treated as a mechanistic signal than a decisive method paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is from the University of Maryland, College Park. Soheil Feizi and Tianyi Zhou are recognizable names in robustness, controllability, and foundation-model analysis.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但若你关心表征是否在前几步就锁定行为，可只看 ASTEER 设定和早期 hidden-state 特征，别花时间在应用层结果上。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but if you care whether behavior is effectively fixed in the first few decoding steps, read the ASTEER setup and early hidden-state features, not the application-layer results.

paper.title: Recoverable but Not Stationary:Local Linear Structures in Weights and Activations
paper.abstract: Task vectors, LoRA, activation steering, and random search around pretrained weights all suggest that learned behaviour can be controlled by linear directions. We ask which linear structures actually exist and on what scale. In a synthetic multitask transformer and LoRA adapters on DistilGPT-2 / GPT-2 we find strong local low-rank task-gradient structure but reject the fixed-task-plane hypothesis: static bases miss the recovery direction, and the useful basis drifts substantially within 100 step

summary.core_problem: 现有后训练适配方法（任务向量、LoRA、激活调控、随机参数搜索）均依赖一个未被系统验证的几何假设：预训练模型的权重或激活空间中存在静态的局部线性低秩子空间可用于控制任务行为。该工作系统验证了这类结构的存在性、适用范围与平稳性，同时解释了高维参数空间中随机参数搜索能找到有效方向这一反直觉现象的原理。
summary.importance: 澄清了学界普遍默认的静态任务平面假设不成立，为预训练checkpoint周围的高维随机搜索有效性提供了理论依据，对LoRA适配、模型合并、激活调控类方法的设计有直接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 设计了遗忘-恢复实验范式：先训练多任务模型，再过拟合单任务诱导其他任务遗忘，随后短时间重训恢复任务性能，以梯度下降得到的恢复位移Δ_GD作为基准衡量不同子空间的对齐程度。在合成Transformer、DistilGPT-2/GPT-2的LoRA适配、Qwen2.5-0.5B模型上开展实验刻画子空间的动态特性。提出高斯局部线性定理，证明各向同性高斯扰动捕获的有效信号方差与参数维度无关，best-of-N采样会以√logN系数放大有效信号，从理论上解释随机搜索的有效性。同时建立了权重扰动与激活调控向量的形式化关联并完成实证验证。
summary.experiments: 核心实验结果包括：1）静态任务平面假设不成立：遗忘checkpoint处测得的任务梯度子空间仅能捕获少量恢复位移，遗忘前测得的子空间几乎无法捕获，且有效子空间在100步训练内就会发生明显漂移。2）由恢复前几步梯度构成的轨迹前缀基可以捕获77%的LoRA恢复位移，效果优于所有静态子空间。3）Qwen2.5-0.5B上扰动尺度约1e-4时处于局部线性区，随机搜索的有效信号增益随√logN增长，与参数数量无关。4）单步权重扰动对应的激活“影子”与独立构造的对比调控向量余弦相似度约0.58，在解码器深层效果峰值。
summary.reading_guide: 先阅读引言部分理解核心观察与研究问题，再了解遗忘-恢复实验范式的设计，重点查看核心结论示意图Figure 1、高斯局部线性定理的表述与验证、权重空间与激活空间结构关联的实验。预计阅读时间30-40分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing post-training adaptation methods including task vectors, LoRA, activation steering, and random parameter search rely on an unvalidated geometric assumption: that static, locally linear low-rank subspaces exist in pretrained model weight or activation space to control task behavior. This work systematically verifies the existence, scope, and stationarity of such structures, and explains the counterintuitive effectiveness of random parameter search in high-dimensional parameter spaces.
summary_en.importance: Disproves the widely assumed static task plane hypothesis, provides theoretical justification for high-dimensional random search around pretrained checkpoints, and offers direct guidance for the design of LoRA adaptation, model merging, and activation steering methods.
summary_en.technical_approach: A forgetting-recovery experimental paradigm is designed: a multitask model is overfit to a single task to induce forgetting of other tasks, then briefly retrained to restore lost performance, with the gradient-derived recovery displacement Δ_GD used as the ground-truth reference to measure subspace alignment. Experiments are conducted on synthetic transformers, LoRA adapters on DistilGPT-2/GPT-2, and Qwen2.5-0.5B to characterize subspace dynamics. A Gaussian local linear theorem is proposed to prove that the variance of useful signal captured by isotropic Gaussian perturbations is independent of parameter dimension, and best-of-N sampling amplifies the signal by a √logN factor, justifying random search effectiveness. A formal connection between weight perturbations and activation steering vectors is also established and empirically validated.
summary_en.experiments: Key results: 1) The static task plane hypothesis is rejected: task gradient subspaces measured at the forgotten checkpoint capture only a small fraction of recovery displacement, and subspaces measured before forgetting capture almost none; useful subspaces drift substantially within 100 training steps. 2) A trajectory-prefix basis built from the first several recovery steps captures 77% of LoRA recovery displacement, outperforming all static subspaces. 3) Random search operates in a local linear regime at perturbation scale ~1e-4 on Qwen2.5-0.5B, with signal gain scaling with √logN independent of parameter count. 4) The activation "shadow" of a single-step weight perturbation has ~0.58 cosine similarity to an independently constructed contrastive steering vector, with peak effect at late decoder layers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to grasp the core observations and research questions, then review the forgetting-recovery experimental paradigm, focus on Figure 1 illustrating the core conclusion, the statement and validation of the Gaussian local linear theorem, and experiments linking weight and activation space structures. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了固定任务平面的默认共识，对LoRA和激活转向的设计有直接指导，重点读§3的漂移实验和高斯局部线性定理推导。
recommendation.en: Overturns the default consensus of fixed task plane, provides direct guidance for LoRA and activation steering design; focus on §3 drift experiments and Gaussian local linearity theorem derivation.

paper.title: TimpaTeks: Automatic In-place Text Sequence Modification via Diffusion Language Model Steering
paper.abstract: We extend activation steering to diffusion language models (DLMs) and study a novel problem that arose due to the inference mechanism of DLMs: Modifying a text in-place to manifest a different concept. We propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification mechanism using DLMs. Experiments on IMDB movie reviews (sentiment) and a synthetic Cats and Dogs Dataset (arbitrary, more unconventional concept steering) show that TimpaTeks provides a feasible novel mechanism to steer diffusion langu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究 diffusion language model 的一个特有能力：能否在不重写整句的情况下，对已有文本做原位修改并定向改变语义概念。
summary.importance: 它的价值在于把 activation steering 扩展到 DLM，并利用 DLM 非自回归、可局部重写的生成机制，展示一种 AR LM 不太自然的编辑范式。对研究新型语言建模范式的人有一点启发，但目前任务设置较小。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 TimpaTeks，用 DLM 的去噪过程做 automatic in-place text modification。方法核心是把 activation steering 注入 diffusion LM 的推理过程，使模型在原位去噪时朝目标概念偏移，同时尽量保留原句结构。相比 prompt-based steering，它不需要额外构造条件提示，而是在原序列上直接编辑。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 IMDB 影评情感修改和一个 Cats vs Dogs 合成数据集上，评估概念切换、句子结构保留和困惑度变化。摘要声称能在保持原句结构的同时降低句子 perplexity，并且比基于提示的 DLM steering 更省算力。但没有看到大模型、开放域文本或强基线验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a DLM-specific capability: whether a diffusion language model can modify an existing text in place and shift its semantic concept without rewriting the whole sequence.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is extending activation steering to diffusion LMs and exploiting the non-autoregressive, locally editable nature of DLMs. This is mildly interesting for alternative language modeling paradigms, though the current setup is small-scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose TimpaTeks, an automatic in-place text modification method built on diffusion LM denoising. The key idea is to inject activation steering into the DLM inference process so that denoising moves the sequence toward a target concept while preserving the original sentence structure. Unlike prompt-based steering, it edits the sequence directly rather than generating a new conditioned output.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on IMDB sentiment editing and a synthetic Cats-and-Dogs concept dataset, evaluating concept transfer, structure preservation, and perplexity. The abstract claims lower sentence perplexity and lower compute cost than prompt-based DLM steering, but there is no evidence yet of large-scale models, open-domain text, or strong baselines.

recommendation.zh: 点子不坏，但更像 DLM 可编辑性的 demo，不足以支撑范式判断；做 diffusion LM 的人可看，其他人知道有这条路就够了。
recommendation.en: A decent idea, but mostly a demo of DLM editability rather than a paradigm-shifting result; worth a look only if you actively work on diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Steer Where It Matters: Token-Level Visual-Sensitivity Steering for LVLMs Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Large vision language models (LVLMs) have made rapid advancements and are deployed across various applications, yet hallucinations remain a major challenge. Activation steering is appealing due to its minimal training overhead and controllability at inference time. However, we found that during autoregressive decoding, visual conditioning affects token prediction sparsely and locally across decoding steps, and many existing methods that average image-versus-no-image differences over the entire s

summary.core_problem: LVLM 幻觉缓解中，现有 activation steering 往往用全序列平均的“有图-无图”差分方向，信噪比低且固定强度会误伤非关键 token；如何做更细粒度、稳定的视觉条件干预。
summary.importance: 提供一个可操作的诊断：视觉条件对 AR 解码的影响是稀疏且局部的；对 VLM 推理期控制/干预与“哪些 token 真在看图”的机制分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TLVS：提取 token-level 的视觉敏感 steering 向量并做精炼，然后按 token 的视觉敏感度自适应分配 steering strength，在关键 token 上更强、非关键 token 上更弱以减少不稳定与副作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型与数据；宣称相较序列级平均 steering，在幻觉缓解上更有效且更稳定（需看正文具体基准与消融）。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering for LVLM hallucination mitigation often averages image-vs-no-image differences over the whole sequence (low SNR) and uses fixed strength (over-perturbing non-critical tokens); the paper targets token-level, stable visual interventions.
summary_en.importance: Offers a practical diagnostic: visual conditioning affects AR decoding sparsely and locally; useful for inference-time control and for analyzing which tokens truly depend on vision.
summary_en.technical_approach: TLVS extracts and refines token-level visual-sensitivity steering vectors, then applies sensitivity-aware, per-token adaptive steering strength to focus intervention budget on critical tokens and avoid instability.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks model/dataset specifics; it claims improved hallucination mitigation and stability over sequence-averaged steering baselines (check paper for benchmarks/ablations).

recommendation.zh: 把“视觉影响是稀疏 token 事件”讲清楚了；只需看它的敏感度估计方法与自适应强度消融，别被总体指标带跑。
recommendation.en: The key is the 'vision influence is sparse across tokens' framing; read the sensitivity estimator and adaptive-strength ablations, not just aggregate scores.

paper.title: Beyond Linear Activation Steering: Invertible Latent Transformations for Controlling LLM Behavior
paper.abstract: Activation steering provides a lightweight inference-time mechanism for controlling large language models (LLMs) by modifying their internal activation vectors toward desired behaviors. Most existing methods compute a fixed steering direction in the original activation space, typically from pairs of contrastive examples using mean differences, linear probes, or arbitrary separability criteria. While effective to a certain extent, these methods treat behavioral control as a global, linear, additi

summary.core_problem: 现有激活steering方法均采用全局线性加性偏移，无法处理激活空间中非线性分布的行为特征，固定 steering方向在复杂控制场景下效果受限
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出基于可逆隐空间变换的非线性激活steering框架，突破了线性steering的表达能力限制
summary.technical_approach: 提出INNSteer框架，将激活向量映射到可逆变换后的隐空间计算steering方向，支持输入依赖的非线性干预，无需重新训练模型即可实现更精准的行为控制
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露实验设置与量化性能结果，仅提出了方法框架
summary.authors_note: 未标注作者所属机构

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation steering methods use global linear additive offsets, cannot handle nonlinearly distributed behavioral features in activation space, and fixed steering directions have limited performance in complex control scenarios
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first proposes a nonlinear activation steering framework based on invertible latent transformations, breaking the expressiveness limit of linear steering
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the INNSteer framework, maps activation vectors to an invertibly transformed latent space to compute steering directions, supports input-dependent nonlinear interventions, and enables more precise behavior control without retraining
summary_en.experiments: Paper abstract does not fully disclose experimental setup and quantitative performance results, only the method framework is proposed
summary_en.authors_note: No institutional affiliation of authors is disclosed

recommendation.zh: 激活steering从线性扩展到非线性的增量工作，对齐方向研究员可重点看可逆变换的设计部分，其余可略过
recommendation.en: Incremental work extending activation steering from linear to nonlinear, alignment researchers can focus on the invertible transformation design and skip the rest

paper.title: Shared Latent Structures Enable Unified Backdoor Detection and Mitigation in LLMs
paper.abstract: Backdoor attacks in large language models (LLMs) are often treated as isolated trigger-response failures, motivating defenses tailored to specific triggers or behaviors. We show this view is incomplete. Across diverse backdoor behaviors, we identify a shared latent mechanism that can be detected, causally controlled, and suppressed. Using sparse autoencoders (SAEs) on residual-stream activations, we find a small set of latent features consistently activated across jailbreaking, refusal manipulat

summary.core_problem: LLM 中的后门攻击是否共享底层的潜在机制，能否被统一检测和缓解？
summary.importance: 挑战了将后门攻击视为孤立触发器-响应失败的传统观点，发现跨多种攻击类型和模型存在共享的潜在特征，为统一防御提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 使用稀疏自编码器 (SAE) 分析残差流激活，发现一小部分潜在特征在越狱、拒绝操纵等多种后门行为中一致激活。通过双向激活引导 (activation steering) 验证了这些特征的因果性。
summary.experiments: 在 4B 到 32B 参数的 Qwen3、Gemma 3 和 Llama 3.1 模型上，跨越微调和权重编辑攻击进行了验证。训练了轻量级 SAE 特征分类器。

summary_en.core_problem: Do backdoor attacks in LLMs share underlying latent mechanisms, and can they be uniformly detected and mitigated?
summary_en.importance: Challenges the conventional view of treating backdoor attacks as isolated trigger-response failures, discovering shared latent features across various attack types and models, providing a new perspective for unified defense.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) on residual-stream activations to find a small set of latent features consistently activated across multiple backdoor behaviors (jailbreaking, refusal manipulation, etc.). Validates the causality of these features through bidirectional activation steering.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3, Gemma 3, and Llama 3.1 models ranging from 4B to 32B parameters, across both fine-tuning and weight-editing attacks. Trained lightweight SAE-feature classifiers.

recommendation.zh: 用 SAE 发现不同 backdoor 攻击共享 latent feature，证明了激活空间的结构化，对理解模型安全性和表示学习有启发，值得看实验部分。
recommendation.en: Uses SAEs to discover shared latent features across different backdoor attacks, proving the structure of the activation space. Inspiring for understanding model safety and representation learning; the experimental section is worth reading.

paper.title: Adversarial Robustness of Activation Steering in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Activation steering has become a popular training-free method to control LLM behavior by injecting precomputed direction vectors into the model's residual stream at inference time. Yet its robustness to realistic input variation remains unstudied. We present the first systematic evaluation of activation steering robustness under adversarial text perturbations on the inputs, covering four extraction methods, three attack strategies, six personas from Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset, an

summary.core_problem: 评估大语言模型中激活引导（Activation Steering）方法在面对输入文本对抗性扰动时的鲁棒性。
summary.importance: 首次系统性地揭示了激活引导这种免训练控制方法在真实输入变化下的脆弱性，对依赖该方法进行模型对齐和控制的实践提出了挑战。
summary.technical_approach: 对 4 种向量提取方法、3 种攻击策略、6 种角色设定以及 5 个不同规模（1.5B 到 30B）的模型进行对抗性文本扰动测试，分析引导强度、置信度和最佳注入层的变化。
summary.experiments: 在 Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset 上进行测试。结果显示攻击在所有设置下广泛成功：方向鲁棒性下降高达 64%，攻击后置信度崩溃至 0.25 附近或更低，且最佳注入层在扰动下偏移高达 17 个位置。

summary_en.core_problem: Evaluating the robustness of activation steering methods in Large Language Models against adversarial text perturbations on the input.
summary_en.importance: Provides the first systematic evaluation revealing the fragility of activation steering, a popular training-free control method, under realistic input variations, challenging its reliability for model alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tests adversarial text perturbations across 4 vector extraction methods, 3 attack strategies, 6 personas, and 5 models (1.5B to 30B parameters), analyzing changes in steering strength, confidence, and optimal injection layers.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the Anthropic Model-Written Evaluation Dataset. Attacks succeed broadly: directional robustness drops up to 64%, post-attack confidence collapses near or below 0.25, and the optimal injection layer shifts by up to 17 positions under perturbation.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了 Activation Steering 在对抗扰动下的脆弱性，特别是最佳注入层的偏移现象，对做 mechanistic interpretability 和 inference-time control 的研究员有警示作用。
recommendation.en: Reveals the fragility of Activation Steering under adversarial perturbations, especially the shift of optimal injection layers, serving as a cautionary tale for mechanistic interpretability and inference-time control research.

paper.title: LLM Self-Recognition: Steering and Retrieving Activation Signatures
paper.abstract: Recent advances in interpretability suggest that large language models (LLMs) implicitly encode signals in their generated text that enable self-recognition of their outputs. We demonstrate that this capability is reliable, even in low-entropy scenarios, and that it can be amplified through targeted intervention. By steering the internal residual stream during generation with a random sparse vector, we create a detectable fingerprint that enables attribution of a given text to a specific LLM. Th

summary.core_problem: 传统AI生成内容检测方法依赖外部嵌入水印，易被干扰，现有LLM隐式自识别能力的可靠性和可放大性缺乏系统验证。
summary.importance: 机制与方法创新，验证了LLM自识别能力的可靠性，提出了基于激活干预的无外部水印文本归因方案。
summary.technical_approach: 在生成过程中向残差流注入随机稀疏向量作为可检测指纹，利用LLM自身的激活信号检测文本归属，无需外部嵌入水印且保留文本生成质量。
summary.experiments: 在多种检测场景下实现超过98%的归因准确率，同时验证了生成文本的质量无明显下降。

summary_en.core_problem: Traditional AI-generated content detection methods rely on externally embedded watermarks that are vulnerable to tampering, while the reliability and amplifiability of implicit self-recognition capabilities in LLMs lack systematic verification.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism and methodological innovation, verifying the reliability of LLM self-recognition capabilities and proposing an activation-intervention-based text attribution scheme without external watermarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inject random sparse vectors into the residual stream during generation as detectable fingerprints, and use an LLM's own activation signals to detect text attribution, with no external watermark embedding and preserved generation quality.
summary_en.experiments: Achieve over 98% attribution accuracy across multiple detection settings, with no significant degradation in generated text quality verified.

recommendation.zh: 属于可解释性领域的应用向研究，仅激活干预的实现细节对预训练研究员有微弱参考价值。
recommendation.en: Application-oriented research in interpretability, with only implementation details of activation intervention having marginal reference value for pretraining researchers.

paper.title: Steering Vectors are an Adversarial Attack Surface
paper.abstract: Activation steering has become a popular way to control Large Language Model (LLM) behavior without fine-tuning. Since the technique is plug-and-play, users share datasets and precomputed vectors to steer model activations. However, we show that a \emph{stealth data poisoning attack} silently compromises this pipeline. By substituting $4{-}6\%$ of tokens in the steering dataset, an attacker can silently align the resulting vector with an anti-refusal direction. This jailbreaks the target model w

summary.core_problem: 激活 steering 向量作为即插即用控制手段，存在被数据投毒后悄悄转成 jailbreak 方向的安全攻击面。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练论文，但对后训练与推理时控制方法有现实意义：很多人把 steering 当轻量安全可控工具，这篇指出其供应链风险和可验证性错觉。
summary.technical_approach: 作者设计 stealth data poisoning attack：只替换 steering 数据集中 4-6% 的 token，就能让得到的 steering vector 与 anti-refusal 方向对齐，同时保留表面上的原始 steering 效果。攻击者甚至可以连同文本、向量、权重和“等价性证书”一起分发，使终端用户难以察觉。
summary.experiments: 在两个开源模型家族、八种 model-attribute 组合上测试，poisoned vectors 的绝对攻击成功率达到 20%-55%，比干净参考高 19%-51%。摘要未给出更细的模型规模与防御细节；若要读，只需看 threat model、攻击构造和 transfer/stealth trade-off。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering, often used as a plug-and-play control method, can be silently poisoned so that the resulting steering vector becomes a jailbreak direction.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it matters for post-training and inference-time control. Many practitioners treat steering as a lightweight and relatively safe control tool; this paper argues that the supply chain is an attack surface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose a stealth data-poisoning attack: by replacing only 4-6% of tokens in the steering dataset, the resulting vector aligns with an anti-refusal direction while preserving the apparent intended steering behavior. The attacker can even distribute texts, vectors, weights, and an 'equivalence certificate' that appears verifiable to users.
summary_en.experiments: The attack is tested on two open-weight model families and eight model-attribute combinations, where poisoned vectors achieve 20%-55% absolute attack success rate, improving by 19%-51% over clean references. The key parts to inspect are the threat model, attack construction, and the stealth/transfer trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座主线，但它提醒你别把 steering 当无害插件；看 threat model 和攻击表就够了，方法本身不必深读。
recommendation.en: Not core to pretraining, but it is a useful reminder not to treat steering as a harmless plug-in; the threat model and attack table are enough.

paper.title: SALSA: Speech Aware LLM Adaptation via Learned Steering Activation Vectors

summary.core_problem: 如何在不重训大模型的前提下，让文本 LLM 更“听得懂”语音相关信号（口音、韵律、说话人特征等）并把这些因素用于下游对话/理解任务。
summary.importance: 属于轻量适配与表示操控：用 activation steering 的方式把“语音感知”注入 LLM，可能对多模态统一建模里的“后接入式适配”有参考，但更偏 post-hoc 适配而非基座预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 学习一组 steering activation vectors（类似可训练方向/子空间），在推理或微调时对中间层激活做加性/门控式偏置，使模型输出对语音属性更敏感；核心在于如何从带语音标注/对齐的数据中估计这些方向，以及如何在不破坏语言能力的情况下施加干预。
summary.experiments: 在语音相关的 NLP 任务上对比：无适配、全参微调、LoRA/Adapter 等；报告在不同语音属性/噪声条件下的提升与副作用（具体任务、数据与增益需看正文）。
summary.authors_note: UIUC + KAIST；Mark Hasegawa-Johnson、Julia Hockenmaier 团队在语音/语言交叉方向有长期积累。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make a text LLM more aware of speech-related signals (accent, prosody, speaker traits, etc.) without full retraining, and leverage them for downstream understanding/dialog tasks.
summary_en.importance: A lightweight adaptation / representation-steering approach: injecting “speech awareness” via activation steering may inform plug-in style multimodal adaptation, though it is more post-hoc than foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Learns steering activation vectors (trainable directions/subspaces) and applies additive/gated interventions to intermediate activations during inference or adaptation, making outputs sensitive to speech attributes. Key is estimating these directions from speech-aligned/annotated data while minimizing degradation of core language capability.
summary_en.experiments: Compares against no adaptation, full finetuning, and parameter-efficient baselines (LoRA/adapters), reporting gains and side effects across speech attributes/noise conditions (exact tasks/data/margins require the paper).
summary_en.authors_note: UIUC + KAIST; Mark Hasegawa-Johnson and Julia Hockenmaier have a long track record in speech-language research.

recommendation.zh: 当作“多模态后接入”小技巧看：重点看 steering 向量怎么学、怎么插层、以及对纯文本能力的副作用评估；别指望它回答预训练范式问题。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a plug-in multimodal trick: focus on how steering vectors are learned/applied and the measured collateral damage on pure-text ability; it won’t answer pretraining-paradigm questions.

institutions: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology

paper.title: Cross-Lingual Steering for Figurative Language Generation
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models can generate figurative language, but whether the internal signals driving this behavior are language-specific or reusable across languages is unclear. Using activation steering as a probe, we estimate a direction for a figurative category from figurative--literal activation differences in one language and apply it during generation. Across five figurative categories, six languages, and four multilingual LLMs, these directions steer reliably within their own la

summary.core_problem: 论文用 activation steering 研究多语 LLM 中的修辞生成信号是否可跨语言复用：从一种语言的“修辞句 - 字面句”激活差中估计方向，再把该方向加到另一种语言的生成过程中，看它能否提高目标修辞类型的出现率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近表示分析和可控生成，不是预训练 recipe。但它对基座研究有一个清楚启发：多语模型内部存在可干预的共享行为方向，而且这种方向不只对应语言 ID 或表层词汇。对多语预训练、跨语对齐和 activation-based interpretability 都有参考意义。它也提示，模型在训练中学到的高层语义/语用特征可能以低维方向或共享子空间形式存在，后续可以用于分析数据配比、语言迁移和能力泛化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 Contrastive Activation Addition。对语言 g 和修辞类别 c，作者收集最多 500 个修辞正例和 500 个同语言字面句负例，在选定层取最后输入 token 的 hidden state 均值差，得到 steering vector。生成时，在 prefill 阶段把该向量以固定强度 alpha=1.0 加到 residual stream 的 prompt-token 位置。实验分三步：先做同语言 steering，确认方向是否能提高本语言目标修辞；再做 zero-shot cross-lingual steering，把源语言方向用于目标语言；最后做几何分析，包括多语言向量聚合和 shared subspace ablation。评价用 DeepSeek-v4-flash 作为 judge，主指标是 Target Category Rate，同时用 0–4 分 coherence 监控生成质量。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖四个多语模型：Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、Ministral-3-8B-Instruct；六种语言：英语、中文、孟加拉语、西班牙语、意大利语、德语；五类修辞：idiom、metaphor、simile、irony、sarcasm。最终生成评测使用每个目标语言 500 条 held-out 字面 prompts，prompt 本身不要求使用修辞，因此 TCR 的上升主要来自激活干预。结果显示，同语言 steering 在 96 个设置中有 74 个显著优于无干预和随机向量控制。跨语言 zero-shot steering 在 416 个设置中有 369 个成功提高目标行为，有些源语言方向可以接近或超过目标语言本地向量。metaphor 和 simile 最稳定；idiom、irony、sarcasm 更受文化和语境影响，迁移波动更大。多语言 aggregate vector 能接近 native-language steering；移除共享子空间后修辞生成明显下降，支持共享几何结构的解释。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看实验设置，确认向量构造、层选择、干预位置和 judge 验证方式；再看 monolingual 与 cross-lingual 结果表，重点比较不同修辞类别的迁移差异。几何干预部分最值得看，因为它把“跨语言可迁移”从现象推进到子空间层面的证据。若关注预训练，可主要读 shared subspace、语言差异和类别差异，不必细读每个修辞类别的生成例子。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether the internal signals that support figurative language generation in multilingual LLMs are language-specific or reusable across languages. It estimates a direction from figurative-minus-literal activations in one language and applies that direction during generation in another language.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a representation and controllability study rather than a pretraining recipe. Its relevance to base-model research is that multilingual models appear to contain behaviorally meaningful directions that transfer across languages and are not merely language-ID or surface-form artifacts. This matters for multilingual pretraining, cross-lingual alignment, and activation-level interpretability. It suggests that some semantic and pragmatic behaviors learned during training may be organized as shared low-dimensional directions or subspaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses Contrastive Activation Addition. For a language-category pair, the authors collect up to 500 figurative examples and 500 literal examples in the same language, compute the mean hidden-state difference at the last input-token position for a selected layer, and use that vector as the steering direction. During generation, the vector is added to the residual stream at prompt-token positions in the prefill phase with a fixed strength of alpha=1.0. The study has three components: monolingual steering, zero-shot cross-lingual steering, and geometric interventions. The geometric experiments include multilingual aggregate vectors and ablations of the shared subspace. Outputs are judged by DeepSeek-v4-flash, with Target Category Rate as the main behavioral metric and a 0–4 coherence score as a quality check.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers four multilingual models: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Ministral-3-8B-Instruct. It tests six languages: English, Chinese, Bengali, Spanish, Italian, and German; and five figurative categories: idiom, metaphor, simile, irony, and sarcasm. Final evaluations use 500 held-out literal prompts per target language, and the prompt does not ask for figurative language, so increases in Target Category Rate come from the intervention. Monolingual steering improves targeted figurative behavior in 74 of 96 settings against unsteered and random-vector controls. Zero-shot cross-lingual steering succeeds in 369 of 416 settings, and in some cases a source-language vector matches or exceeds the vector derived from the target language itself. Metaphor and simile are the most stable categories, while idiom, irony, and sarcasm show more variability because they depend more on culture and discourse context. Aggregate multilingual vectors often rival native-language vectors, and ablating the shared subspace sharply reduces figurative generation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes around 20–30 minutes. Start with the experimental setup to check vector construction, layer selection, intervention sites, and judge validation. Then read the monolingual and cross-lingual result tables, focusing on category-level differences rather than only average gains. The geometric-intervention section is the most useful part for model researchers, because it provides evidence that transfer is mediated by a shared representational component. For pretraining interests, prioritize the shared-subspace results and the language/category asymmetries; the individual generation examples are secondary.

recommendation.zh: 只看 steering transfer 和 shared-component 消融；它给 multilingual pretrain 的共享语义方向一个可测信号。
recommendation.en: Read the transfer results and shared-component ablation; it gives a measurable signal for shared semantic directions in multilingual pretraining.

paper.title: Latent Space Disentanglement via Activation Steering for Interpretable Attribute Control in Symbolic Music Generation
paper.abstract: Transformer-based architectures have significantly advanced the generation of complex symbolic sequences, yet a significant gap remains in achieving fine-grained, interpretable control over discrete signal attributes. This paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of the Multitrack Music Transformer (MMT) and proposes a framework for deterministic attribute modulation without retraining to bridge this gap via inference-time activation steering. Utilizing the Difference-in-Means (DiffMe

summary.core_problem: 在基于Transformer的符号音乐生成模型（如MMT）中，如何在不重新训练的情况下实现对离散输出属性（音高、时长）的细粒度、可解释的推理时控制。
summary.importance: 将机械可解释性方法（DiffMean、激活导向、线性表示假说）从LLM领域推广到符号音乐生成，验证了跨领域的适用性；对LLM预训练研究员的启发在于：残差流中属性的分层编码规律（节奏特征在浅层、旋律特征在深层）可能反映了通用Transformer的层次化表示策略，可迁移到理解语言模型的内部表示结构。
summary.technical_approach: 在预训练的MMT（decoder-only，512维，SOD数据集）中，通过前向钩子截取每一层残差流输出，用DiffMean方法（高/低属性簇的均值差，各1280样本）提取音高和时长的导向向量。通过层敏感度分析发现音高在第11层线性可分性最强，时长在第2层最强。评估了三种注入策略（All-to-All、One-to-All、Some-to-Some），All-to-All效果最稳健。针对音高-时长特征耦合（cos相似度最高0.81，均值0.49），对比了简单相加、Gram-Schmidt优先级正交化和SVD对称正交化四种解耦方案。
summary.experiments: 核心实验包括：（1）层敏感度分析确认不同属性的最优编码层不同；（2）线性表示假说验证：导向强度与属性偏移量高度相关；（3）多属性独立控制的正交化方法比较。具体指标：每类属性的高/低阈值取SOD语料的20/80分位数，每簇1280样本。All-to-All策略在导向强度与生成质量之间取得最佳平衡。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看§III Method的敏感度分析部分（图1和正交化策略），了解不同属性在Transformer层中的编码层次规律。对LLM研究员可快速浏览方法框架，重点提取机械可解释性方法的跨领域迁移思路，正交化解耦特征的技术值得参考。阅读时间约20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自Orfium等机构，第一作者Giannis Prokopiou。项目页含音频示例和代码：https://giannisprokopiouorfium.github.io/music-transformer-sae/

summary_en.core_problem: How to achieve fine-grained, interpretable inference-time control over discrete output attributes (pitch, duration) in Transformer-based symbolic music generation models (e.g. MMT) without retraining.
summary_en.importance: Extends mechanistic interpretability methods (DiffMean, activation steering, Linear Representation Hypothesis) from LLMs to symbolic music generation, validating cross-domain applicability. For LLM pretraining researchers, the layered encoding pattern observed (rhythmic features encoded earlier, melodic features later) may reflect a general Transformer representation strategy that could inform the understanding of internal representations in language models.
summary_en.technical_approach: In a pre-trained MMT (decoder-only, 512-dim, trained on SOD dataset), forward hooks intercept the residual stream output at each layer. DiffMean (mean difference between high/low attribute clusters, 1,280 samples each) extracts steering vectors for Pitch and Duration. Layer sensitivity analysis reveals pitch is most linearly separable at Layer 11, duration at Layer 2. Three injection strategies are evaluated (All-to-All, One-to-All, Some-to-Some), with All-to-All being most robust. To address feature coupling (max cosine similarity 0.81, mean 0.49 between pitch and duration vectors), four disentanglement methods are compared: simple addition, Gram-Schmidt priority orthogonalization, and SVD-based symmetric orthogonalization.
summary_en.experiments: Key experiments include: (1) Layer sensitivity analysis confirming different attributes have different optimal encoding layers; (2) Validation of the Linear Representation Hypothesis: high correlation between steering magnitude and attribute shift; (3) Comparison of orthogonalization methods for independent multi-attribute control. Thresholds set at 20th/80th quantiles of the SOD corpus, 1,280 samples per cluster. All-to-All achieves best trade-off between steering potency and generation quality.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on §III Method, especially the sensitivity analysis (Figure 1) and orthogonalization strategies. LLM researchers can quickly grasp the framework and extract cross-domain transfer of mechanistic interpretability methods; the orthogonalization technique for disentangling features is worth noting. Reading time ~20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from Orfium and other institutions, lead author Giannis Prokopiou. Project page with audio examples and code: https://giannisprokopiouorfium.github.io/music-transformer-sae/

recommendation.zh: 在音乐生成领域验证了线性表示假设和激活转向方法，对理解Transformer内部表示结构有参考价值，重点看§3的DiffMean方法和§4的正交化解耦
recommendation.en: Validates the Linear Representation Hypothesis and activation steering in music generation — informative for understanding Transformer internal representation structure; focus on §3 DiffMean and §4 orthogonalization decoupling

paper.title: UniSteer: Text-Guided Flow Matching in Activation Space for Versatile LLM Steering
paper.abstract: Activation-based control steers large language models (LLMs) by intervening on their internal representations during inference, and has emerged as an effective paradigm for controlling behaviors such as persona and style. However, existing methods often rely on fixed steering directions or task-specific intervention modules, making them difficult to adapt to fine-grained concepts and compositional constraints. We propose UniSteer, a text-guided activation flow matching model that learns a condit

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM激活引导方法依赖预定义的固定转向向量或任务专属干预模块，每个目标行为需单独拟合，无法通过自然语言灵活指定细粒度控制目标，且多行为约束组合时，不同方向在高维激活空间中易产生干扰。
summary.importance: 将流匹配范式引入LLM内部激活空间的建模，为推理时的模型行为控制提供了无需微调权重的统一框架，同时为激活空间的语义分析、可解释性研究提供了新的工具路径。
summary.technical_approach: 基于流匹配框架学习文本条件的激活空间通用速度场，无需为每个目标行为单独拟合干预策略：1）训练阶段冻结目标LLM，提取选定层的残差流激活，与描述目标行为/约束的自然语言条件配对；用冻结文本编码器编码条件，通过交叉注意力或自适应归一化注入流模型，训练模型学习从随机噪声到对应条件下激活的条件变换。2）推理阶段对输入激活先在源条件下做部分流反转，再在目标条件下前向传输完成编辑；多约束组合直接体现在条件文本中，无需事后融合独立训练的转向组件。3）同一模型可通过比较不同条件下的激活重建能量，实现激活空间的语义分类。
summary.experiments: 公开的全文内容未包含完整实验章节，目前仅披露方法框架与激活引导、激活空间分类两个核心应用场景的设计逻辑。
summary.reading_guide: 优先阅读引言中现有激活引导方法的局限性梳理、方法部分的条件流匹配与流反转推理设计，若后续补充完整实验可重点关注多约束组合场景的效果对比。预计泛读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation-based LLM steering methods rely on predefined fixed steering vectors or task-specific intervention modules.
