summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis，保留“概念可以线性表达”的设定，但放松 Linear Representation Hypothesis 里的正交假设。核心观点是：真实表示中多个概念贡献会重叠，概念差异不再对应一个干净的全局方向，而会形成样本相关的几何结构。这个结构包含三部分：axis 表示概念存在与否的主差异方向；normal plane 表示与主轴正交的局部变化平面；sensitive sectors 表示在该平面中对生成行为更敏感的区域。这样可以解释一个常见现象：两个 steering vectors 与目标概念方向夹角相近，但投影到某个样本的 normal plane 后落入不同 sector，最终产生不同干预效果。与 LRH 相比，CRH 不再把不稳定性归因于噪声或未充分 disentangle，而是把它看成概念重叠后的几何后果。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在 100 个概念、多个模型架构和多种 steering 实现上验证了圆柱结构的存在，并观察到该结构能解释样本级 steering 差异。可见正文中没有给出具体模型列表、参数规模、数据集构成或数值提升，因此实验部分更适合作为机制假设的经验支持来读，而不是作为可直接复现实验结论的性能报告。最有信息量的实验点应是：axis 分解能估计总体 steering 强度，但 normal plane 内的 sensitive sector 难以由同一线性信息预测，这对应了“趋势可估计、单样本结果难预测”的结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中 Figure 1 对 LRH 与 CRH 的几何对比，以及 Limitations of the Linear Representation Hypothesis 中关于有限维空间无法容纳任意多正交独立概念的反例。若只关心预训练表示机制，可以跳过 steering 工程细节，关注三个问题：CRH 如何定义 axis/normal plane/sensitive sectors；它如何解释 separability 与实际 steering 成功率脱钩；实验是否真的区分了 CRH 与普通的非线性局部效应。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical failure mode of activation steering: even when steering vectors look similar under global linear metrics, their effects can vary sharply across individual prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly mechanistic rather than a new pretraining recipe. It is relevant for researchers who use representation directions as evidence of concepts, control handles, or safety interventions. The main caution is that global linear separability is not enough to predict steerability. Concept directions can overlap, and the local geometry around each sample can dominate the intervention outcome.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes the Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis. It keeps the useful part of the Linear Representation Hypothesis, namely that concepts can have linear components, but removes the stronger assumption that independent concepts can be made orthogonal without loss. Under CRH, concept differences are decomposed into an axis, a normal plane, and sensitive sectors. The axis captures the dominant absence-versus-presence direction of a concept. The normal plane captures sample-specific residual structure. Sensitive sectors are regions in that plane where a steering perturbation is more likely to activate or suppress the target behavior. This gives a concrete explanation for unstable steering: two vectors may have similar angular alignment with the target axis, but their projections into a sample’s normal plane can land in different sectors and produce different outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports verification experiments over 100 concepts, multiple model architectures, and multiple steering implementations. The main empirical claim is that a consistent cylindrical structure appears across these settings and explains sample-level irregularity. The provided text does not expose the exact model names, parameter counts, datasets, or numerical effect sizes. The key experimental takeaway is therefore qualitative: axis-based decomposition can estimate aggregate steering intensity, while the sector structure inside the normal plane remains difficult to infer and accounts for single-sample unpredictability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the geometric comparison in Figure 1, then read the section on the limitations of the Linear Representation Hypothesis, especially the finite-dimensional counterexample showing why many independent concepts cannot all be orthogonalized. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful questions are: how the paper operationalizes axis, normal plane, and sensitive sectors; whether CRH predicts failures that separability metrics miss; and whether the empirical tests separate CRH from generic local nonlinearity.

recommendation.zh: 适合 skim：§几何假设和实验检验最有用；若你还默认 steering 是单方向线性控制，这篇会提醒你看法平面里的干扰。
recommendation.en: Skim the geometry and validation sections; if your steering prior is still one-vector linear control, the useful bit is the normal-plane interference story.

commentary.article_excerpt: Lang 关注 【ICML2026】LLM的概念表征可能呈圆柱形 宣传一下最近被 ICML 接收的可解释性工作，提出了一个比线性表示假设更贴近现实的理论框架，欢迎交流指点！ 🎛️ 问题在哪？ 给大语言模型插入一个控制向量（steering）是引导它输出特定内容的好方法——比如让它说话更礼貌、更专业、更简洁。但有个让人头疼的问题：同样的方法，有时候有用，有时候没用，甚至适得其反，而且尚无可靠的解释。 📐 现有解释有什么问题？ 学术界主流用"线性表示假设"（LRH）来解释 steering：模型把每个概念编码为一个方向向量，往那个方向推一把，概念就出来了。但 LRH 有个前提：独立概念之间必须能被映射成互相正交的方向。而现实是，模型要表示的概念数量远超它的维度，根本做不到全部正交。 这意味着：steering 的不稳定可能不是偶然噪声，而是有更深层的几何原因。 🥁 我们发现了什么？ 通过广泛的观测，我们怀疑概念可能不止是线性编码的。提出了柱面表示假设（CRH），把模型的概念表征想象成一个圆柱体，对于每个输入样本有： 🏹 中轴：激活目标概念的最理想方向，沿轴推进能稳定触发目标概念； 🪐 法平面：垂直于轴的横截面，反映其他概念的干扰分布； 🎯 敏感 vs 非敏感扇区：法平面会自然分为两类区域：落入敏感扇区概念激活顺畅，落入非敏感扇区则被压制甚至反向。 实际使用的 steering 向量会被分解成中轴分量和法平面分量。前者的大小可以观测，但法平面分量落在哪个扇区无法从外部预测。这就解释了为什么两个看起来几乎一样的控制向量，效果可以天差地别。 🧪 有没有实验验证？ 我们用100种概念、多个模型架构和steer方法开展了广泛的观测试验，CRH在统计学上能够得到证实。我们希望在未来，CRH会有助于开发更加简洁、高效、可控的模型操纵手段。 📄 论文地址 https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.01844 (图片含义： P1: 论文页 P2: 📐 LRH的矛盾点 P3: 🥁 CRH vs LRH P4: 🥁 CRH的结构构想 P5: 🧪 对单个样本steer所探测出来的圆柱形结构 P6: 论文的评审页，给分比较慷慨 ） 题外话：这篇论文的诞生恰恰源于本人在2025.10.27的发帖 ，原本想尝试也建模成螺旋线，但确定一条螺旋线实在过于复杂繁琐。CRH是“螺旋假设”的简化推广。 #LLM #学术论文 #可解释性 #几何 #提供思路和创新点 #科研 #ai 1天前

paper.title: Manifold Steering Reveals the Shared Geometry of Neural Network Representation and Behavior
paper.abstract: Neural representations carry rich geometric structure; but does that structure causally shape behavior? To address this question, we intervene along paths through activation space defined by different geometries, and measure the behavioral trajectories they induce. In particular, we test whether interventions that respect the geometry of activation space will yield behaviors close to those the model exhibits naturally. Concretely, we first fit an activation manifold $M_h$ to representations and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的核心问题是：神经网络内部表征的几何结构，是否不仅是描述性的现象，而且会因果性地约束模型行为。更具体地说，常见 activation steering 默认激活空间是欧氏空间，用一条直线方向去推模型；作者质疑这个假设，认为如果真实表征落在弯曲流形上，那么线性干预会穿过低密度、非自然的表示区域，导致输出轨迹失真。论文因此把问题改写为：能否用“沿表示流形的路径”来做干预，并验证这种几何是否与行为空间中的自然变化一一对应。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性有限，它更偏机制分析与可控干预，而不是训练目标、数据或优化本身。但它有两个启发点。第一，它提醒人们不要把线性表示假设当成默认真理；如果大模型内部概念组织更接近低维弯曲流形，那么很多基于线性探针、线性 steering、单方向编辑的结论都可能只在局部成立。第二，它把“表示几何”和“行为几何”联系起来，提供了一种更强的因果检验框架：不是只看能不能改输出，而是看干预路径是否沿着模型自然会走的行为轨迹。对理解 ICL 中概念结构、对齐干预、可解释控制有参考价值，但离预训练方法本身还有一层距离。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步，分别拟合 activation manifold 和 behavior manifold。作者选取具有已知结构的任务，例如星期、月份、字母、年龄这类循环或序列概念，以及 in-context 学到的图结构任务；在视频世界模型里还测试了物理位置。对每个任务，他们从模型内部某层激活中提取对应样本点，拟合一个表示流形 Mh；同时把模型输出在任务相关概念上的概率分布视为行为点，拟合行为流形 My。这里的关键不是简单降维可视化，而是定义流形上的 geodesic distance，并比较它与欧氏距离的差异。

第二步，做 geometry-aware steering。基线方法是常见的 linear steering：在激活上加一个方向向量并调节强度。作者提出的 manifold steering 则不是走直线，而是在拟合出的 Mh 上沿测地线或近似测地路径移动激活。这样做的动机是让干预始终停留在自然激活分布附近，避免切穿流形外部区域。

第三步，验证表示几何与行为几何的对应关系。论文报告两类结果：一类是距离层面的 scaled isometry，即 Mh 上的测地距离与 My 上的测地距离高度对齐，而两者都与欧氏距离不一致；另一类是路径层面的因果验证，即若在激活空间沿 Mh 干预，输出分布会沿 My 的自然轨迹变化。作者还反过来做优化：直接要求行为轨迹贴着 My 走，再看恢复出的激活路径是否自动贴着 Mh 的曲率。这个双向验证比单纯展示“某种 steering 更好用”更扎实。

从方法创新看，真正新的是把 steering 从“找一个方向”改成“选一个几何”，并用 geodesic 语言统一线性 steering、流形 steering 和行为约束 steering。它不是提出新的预训练算法，而是给 activation intervention 提供了更合理的几何框架。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 LLM 和视频世界模型两类系统。语言侧任务包括循环概念如 weekdays、months，顺序概念如 ages、letters，以及 in-context 学到的多维图结构。核心结果有几类。

1. 距离对齐：在这些任务上，activation manifold 与 behavior manifold 的 geodesic distance 呈现接近等距的对应关系，通常只差一个缩放因子；而如果直接用欧氏距离，这种对应明显变差。
2. 路径自然性：线性 steering 往往让行为轨迹穿过低密度区域，出现不自然中间分布、流畅性下降或多样性塌缩；manifold steering 生成的行为轨迹更贴近模型未干预时的自然输出变化。
3. 反向恢复：若直接在行为空间优化一条沿 My 的路径，得到的最优激活轨迹会自动弯向 Mh，而不是保持直线，这支持“表示几何约束行为几何”而非仅仅相关。
4. 跨模态一致性：类似现象不仅出现在语言概念任务，也出现在视频世界模型中的物理位置控制，说明这不是某个单一文本任务的偶然现象。

从给出的全文片段看，作者强调的是几何关系和干预轨迹质量，而不是传统 benchmark 分数。没有完整表格数字时，比较稳妥的阅读方式是关注图中距离相关系数、轨迹可视化和 ablation，而不是追求单一指标。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更适合机制分析方向的读者泛读。先看 Introduction 和方法总览，抓住一句话：作者不是在找更好的 steering vector，而是在问 activation space 应该配什么几何。然后优先看 weekday/month 这类最直观的案例图，因为循环概念最容易看出“直线切过去”和“沿流形绕过去”的差别。接着看距离对齐结果，确认 activation manifold 与 behavior manifold 的 geodesic 是否真的近似等距；这是整篇文章最关键的证据。

如果只花 20 到 30 分钟，建议看三部分：任务设定、manifold steering 方法、线性与流形干预的对比图。若想深一点，再看反向优化行为路径那节，因为它提供了更强的因果支持。对做预训练的人，值得思考的不是是否立刻采用这套方法，而是：很多我们习惯用线性工具分析的表示，是否其实只在局部近似线性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the geometry of neural representations is merely descriptive or whether it causally shapes model behavior. Standard activation steering assumes Euclidean geometry: pick a direction in activation space and move along a straight line. The authors argue that this assumption is often wrong. If natural activations lie on a curved manifold, then linear steering cuts through low-density, off-manifold regions and induces unnatural behavioral transitions. The central question becomes: can interventions that follow the geometry of the representation manifold produce behavioral trajectories that match the model’s own natural behavior manifold?
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect. This is primarily a mechanistic interpretability and intervention paper, not a training-method paper. Still, it offers two useful lessons for foundation-model research. First, it challenges the default linear representation assumption. If concepts are organized on curved low-dimensional manifolds rather than along isolated linear directions, then many conclusions drawn from linear probes, linear steering, and single-direction editing may only hold locally. Second, it proposes a stronger causal test for representation analysis: not just whether an intervention changes outputs, but whether the induced path in behavior space follows the model’s natural geometry. That is useful for understanding controllability, concept structure in in-context learning, and the limits of linear tools.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, the authors fit an activation manifold and a behavior manifold. They use tasks with known latent structure: cyclic concepts such as weekdays and months, sequential concepts such as ages and letters, graph-structured concepts learned in context, and physical position in a video world model. For each task, they collect internal activations from a chosen layer and fit a representation manifold Mh. In parallel, they restrict the output distribution to task-relevant concepts and fit a behavior manifold My. The important point is not just visualization, but the use of manifold geometry and geodesic distances.

Second, they introduce geometry-aware steering. The baseline is standard linear steering, which adds a vector in activation space and scales its magnitude. Their alternative, manifold steering, moves activations along geodesic or approximately geodesic paths on Mh rather than along straight Euclidean lines. The motivation is to keep interventions near the support of natural activations.

Third, they test the link between representation geometry and behavior geometry. One result is a scaled isometry relation: geodesic distances on Mh align closely with geodesic distances on My, while Euclidean distances do not. The other result is path-level causality: steering along Mh induces output trajectories that stay close to My. They also run the reverse experiment by directly optimizing for paths that remain natural in behavior space; the recovered activation trajectories bend to follow Mh rather than staying linear. That reverse recovery makes the argument stronger than a simple “our steering works better” claim.

The main conceptual contribution is to reframe steering from a problem of choosing a direction to a problem of choosing a geometry. In that language, linear steering is just geodesic motion under a flat metric, while manifold steering uses a metric induced by natural activations or behaviors.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments span both language models and a video world model. On the language side, the tasks include cyclic concepts such as weekdays and months, ordered concepts such as ages and letters, and graph-structured concepts learned in context. The main empirical findings are:

1. Distance alignment: geodesic distances on the activation manifold and the behavior manifold are close to isometric up to a scale factor, whereas Euclidean distances fail to capture the same structure.
2. Naturalness of trajectories: linear steering often passes through low-density regions of behavior space and produces unnatural intermediate distributions, degraded fluency, or diversity collapse; manifold steering yields trajectories that more closely match the model’s natural output transitions.
3. Reverse recovery: when the optimization is performed in behavior space to stay on My, the resulting activation trajectory bends to follow the curvature of Mh rather than remaining a straight line.
4. Cross-modal consistency: similar geometry-behavior coupling appears in the video world model for physical position, suggesting the effect is not limited to toy text tasks.

The excerpt provided does not include the full quantitative tables, so it is better to focus on the structure of the evidence than to invent exact numbers. The paper is driven by geometric alignment, trajectory visualizations, and intervention quality rather than by a single benchmark score.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you work on interpretability or activation control. Start with the introduction and the main setup. The key idea to retain is simple: the paper is not searching for a better steering vector, but for the right geometry of activation space. Then look at the weekday or month examples first, because cyclic concepts make the difference between straight-line and manifold-following interventions visually obvious. After that, read the sections showing geodesic-distance alignment between Mh and My; that is the central empirical support for the paper’s claim.

If you only spend 20–30 minutes, focus on three parts: task setup, the manifold-steering procedure, and the comparison figures between linear and manifold interventions. If you want the stronger causal argument, read the reverse optimization experiment where behavior-space constraints recover curved activation trajectories. For pretraining researchers, the useful takeaway is not immediate adoption, but a caution: many representation analyses that look linear may only be locally linear.

recommendation.zh: 看干预 setup 和线性 steering 对照即可；结论若能在 LLM residual stream 上复现，会影响 activation editing 的默认几何假设。
recommendation.en: Read the intervention setup and the linear-steering control; if it transfers to LLM residual streams, it changes the default geometry assumption behind activation editing.

paper.title: Conceptors for Semantic Steering
paper.abstract: Activation-based steering provides control of LLM behavior at inference time, but the dominant paradigm reduces each concept to a single direction whose geometry is left largely unexamined. Rather than selecting a single steering direction, we use conceptors: soft projection matrices estimated from activations pooled across both poles of a bipolar concept, which preserve the concept's full multidimensional subspace. A geometric analysis shows the bipolar subspace strictly subsumes the single-vec

summary.core_problem: 改进基于激活的 LLM 语义 steering：单一方向向量过于粗糙，难以完整表示一个概念的多维几何结构。
summary.importance: 这是推理时控制与表示分析方向的工作，贡献在于把 concept steering 从“单向量”扩展到“子空间投影”，并给出层选择诊断与布尔组合规则。对做 activation engineering、可控生成、概念可分性分析的人有参考价值，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用 conceptor 表示概念：从双极概念两端的激活中估计软投影矩阵，而不是只取一个 steering direction。这样可保留概念对应的多维子空间。文中还提出用 conceptor quota 作为无需额外参数的层选择指标，预测某层概念可分性；并利用 conceptor 的闭式 AND/OR/NOT 运算测试概念组合能力。整体属于对已有 activation steering 的几何化扩展，而非训练新模型。
summary.experiments: 在 3 个 instruction-tuned 模型、3 个语义维度上评估，报告 conceptor quota 与概念可分性的 Pearson 相关最高到 r=0.96。作者还做了五个设计轴的系统比较，结论是 conceptors 在多种设置下与加性 steering 基线持平或更好。摘要未给出模型规模、具体任务集和提升幅度，因此更像方法性 probe，而不是大规模稳健结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 New York University 等机构。未见该摘要对应到基座预训练一线团队，工作更接近 activation engineering 与表示控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets activation-based semantic steering in LLMs, arguing that a single steering vector is too crude to capture the full geometry of a concept.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time control and representation-analysis paper. Its contribution is to replace one-direction steering with subspace-based steering, plus a layer-selection diagnostic and Boolean composition rules. Useful if you care about activation engineering, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of representing a concept by one direction, the authors estimate a conceptor: a soft projection matrix derived from activations pooled from both poles of a bipolar concept. This preserves a multidimensional concept subspace. They also introduce conceptor quota as a parameter-free diagnostic for layer selection, and exploit the closed-form Boolean algebra of conceptors (AND/OR/NOT) to test compositional steering. Overall, this is a geometric extension of existing activation steering rather than a new training paradigm.
summary_en.experiments: They evaluate on three instruction-tuned models and three semantic dimensions, reporting Pearson correlations up to r=0.96 between conceptor quota and concept separability. A five-axis design-space study suggests conceptors match or outperform additive steering baselines in multiple settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmark details, or robust effect sizes, so the evidence looks more methodological than large-scale or definitive.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with New York University and other institutions. The work appears closer to activation engineering and representation control than to core pretraining research.

recommendation.zh: 偏 activation engineering，不是 pretrain 主线；只看 conceptor quota 那部分，若你在做表示探针或 steering 诊断，可拿来替代拍脑袋选层。
recommendation.en: This is activation engineering, not core pretraining; read the conceptor-quota section only if you need a less ad hoc way to choose steering layers.

paper.title: Steer Like the LLM: Activation Steering that Mimics Prompting
paper.abstract: Large language models can be steered at inference time through prompting or activation interventions, but activation steering methods often underperform compared to prompt-based approaches. We propose a framework that formulates prompt steering as a form of activation steering and investigates whether distilling successful prompt steering behavior into simpler, interpretable models can close this gap. Our analysis reveals that popular activation steering methods are not faithful to the mechanics

summary.core_problem: 现有 activation steering（如对某层激活加一个固定 steering vector、全 token 同一系数）在很多任务上不如 prompt steering。论文要回答的是：prompt steering 到底在激活层面“做了什么”，以及能否把这种机制蒸馏成一个更简单、可解释、但效果接近 prompting 的 activation steering 模块。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身（数据/目标/优化/scale）影响不大，但对“推理时控制”与“机制可解释性”有直接启发：1）把 prompting 形式化为一种 activation intervention，有助于把 ICL/提示词的作用落到可测量的内部量上；2）指出常用 constant-coefficient 的 steering 结构性不匹配 prompting 的干预形态（token 位置差异很大），这对后续做更强的 steering、以及把 steering 当作可插拔对齐层（不改权重）有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把“加了 steering prompt 的前向传播”重写为“在原 prompt 的前向传播中，对共享后缀 token 的激活施加一个等价干预”。论文区分两种视角：
- 累积干预（accumulated）：把 prompt 的影响看成从底层到第 l 层累积起来的总差值 Δ_PS_acc。
- 局部干预（local）：在逐层传播时，把 steering prompt token 的激活替换回 unsteered 版本，从而把每一层的净影响抽出来，得到 Δ_PS_loc。
在这个框架下，作者实证分析 prompt steering 的 Δ_PS 在 token 维度上呈现强烈的“非均匀性”：少数 token 位置被强干预，大多数位置几乎不动；而文献中常见的 Const family（ActAdd/CAA/ITI 等）假设对所有位置用同一个 α，天然不匹配。
据此提出 Prompt Steering Replacement（PSR）：仍然使用 rank-1 方向（一个 steering vector z_attr），但把系数从常数 α 变成 token-specific 的 α_i，并且 α_i 由当前 token 的激活（或其可计算特征）预测出来。训练目标是“模仿 prompt steering 造成的激活变化/或输出行为”，相当于把 prompt 的复杂、不可解释的内部干预蒸馏到一个小而可解释的 gating/回归模块上。
论文还讨论了 PSR 何时能表示 prompt steering：需要 prompt 的主要作用在某层附近可被近似为 rank-1 方向 + 位置相关强度（而不是多方向、多机制叠加）。作者承认该假设对所有指令不成立，但认为 token-wise 系数是更一般理论的必要成分。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文片段未包含完整实验表格与具体数值，因此无法可靠复述“提升多少、在哪些模型/基准上”的精确数字。就方法设计与实验设置层面，论文强调：
- 任务是 long-form generation 的 steering，在 3 个 benchmark、多个 LLM 上评估。
- 评价不仅看属性命中，也强调控制“高连贯（high-coherence）完成”的对比，避免 steering 通过破坏流畅性来刷指标。
- 结论是最佳 PSR 配置能与强 steering baseline 相比不落下风，且在连贯性受控时更占优。
若需要精确数字，需要对照论文的实验章节/附录表格（当前输入未提供）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看把 prompt steering 写成 activation intervention 的那一节（含 Figure 1 的三段对照：unsteered / prompted / intervention view），理解 Δ_PS_acc 与 Δ_PS_loc 的定义差异。
2）重点看“prompt 干预在 token 位置上不均匀”的实证图（通常是 token index vs intervention magnitude/α_i 的可视化），这是提出 PSR 的直接证据。
3）再看 PSR 的形式：α_i 如何从激活估计、训练信号如何构造、以及 rank-1 假设的适用边界。
4）最后扫实验：尤其是连贯性控制下的对比，判断它是否真的在“更像 prompting”而不是换一种退化方式。

summary_en.core_problem: Activation steering methods that add a fixed vector with a constant coefficient across tokens often lag behind prompt-based steering. The paper asks what prompt steering is doing in activation space, and whether that behavior can be distilled into a lightweight, interpretable activation-level module that closes the gap to prompting.
summary_en.importance: Limited direct impact on pretraining recipes (data/objectives/optimization), but meaningful for inference-time controllability and mechanistic understanding of prompting/ICL. The key contribution is a structural critique: many steering baselines assume uniform intervention strength across token positions, while prompt steering induces highly token-dependent interventions. This reframes how to design steering modules that better approximate prompting without weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper formalizes prompt steering as an activation intervention on the same generated suffix tokens. It introduces two notions of the prompt-induced intervention: (i) an accumulated effect up to layer l (Δ_PS_acc), and (ii) a layer-local effect (Δ_PS_loc) obtained by “neutralizing” the steering-prompt token activations while propagating the steered suffix, isolating per-layer net changes.
Empirically, the prompt-induced intervention is strongly non-uniform across token positions: a few positions receive large shifts while many are barely affected. This contradicts the common Const family (ActAdd/CAA/ITI/ReFT-R1-style) that applies the same scalar coefficient α everywhere.
Based on this, the paper proposes Prompt Steering Replacement (PSR): keep a rank-1 direction z_attr but replace the constant α with token-specific coefficients α_i predicted from the current activations (a small, interpretable gating/regression module). PSR is trained to imitate the activation changes and/or behavioral effects produced by successful prompt steering, effectively distilling an implicit prompt mechanism into an explicit intervention.
The authors also spell out when PSR can approximate prompting: when the prompt’s dominant effect at the chosen layer can be approximated by a single direction with position-dependent magnitude, rather than multi-directional or more complex dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main result tables or exact numbers, so precise gains, model sizes, and benchmark scores cannot be stated reliably here. From the described setup: PSR is evaluated on long-form generation steering across three benchmarks and multiple LLMs, with an emphasis on comparing methods under matched coherence (to avoid attributing “success” to degraded fluency). The reported qualitative conclusion is that the best PSR configurations are competitive with strong steering baselines, especially when controlling for high-coherence outputs.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Read the section that rewrites prompt steering as activation interventions (and the figure contrasting unsteered vs prompted vs intervention views). Focus on the definitions of Δ_PS_acc vs Δ_PS_loc.
2) Inspect the evidence showing token-position non-uniformity of prompt-induced interventions; this is the main diagnostic that motivates PSR.
3) Read the PSR formulation: how α_i is predicted from activations, what supervision signal is used for distillation, and what assumptions are required for rank-1 approximations.
4) Skim the evaluation with coherence-controlled comparisons to judge whether PSR truly matches prompting rather than trading off fluency.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制部分：若结论站得住，很多线性 steering baseline 的 token-uniform 假设都要重做。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanistic analysis: if the result holds, many token-uniform linear steering baselines need to be rethought.

paper.title: Where Paths Split: Localized, Calibrated Control of Moral Reasoning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models often display heterogeneous moral preferences across settings. We study inference-time steering toward a desired ethical framework while preserving general competence. We present Convergent-Divergent Routing, which traces and edits minimal branch points inside transformer blocks where ethical-framework-related pathways first converge and then diverge. Gating non-target branches at these loci blocks the downstream propagation while leaving upstream computations intact. We fi

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM推理时的道德偏好控制方法（提示工程、带无界系数的转向向量）可解释性差、效果不可控，无法实现不影响通用能力的细粒度道德推理框架切换。
summary.importance: 验证了Transformer内部存在不同道德框架的分流分支点，为对齐研究中直接定位内部表征通路、避免全模型微调提供了思路；提出的有界偏好权重校准方法可改进现有转向向量方案的稳定性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出收敛-分流路由（CDR）方法，先定位Transformer块中功利主义、义务论两种道德框架共享注意力头但FFN单元分流的分支点，通过门控非目标路径实现二元控制；再引入EEG领域的公共空间模式提取每层对应两种框架的判别方向，结合双logit校准，用[0,1]区间的偏好权重实现细粒度控制，全程无需微调，仅推理时修改内部状态。
summary.experiments: 在LLaMA-2-7B-Chat、Vicuna-7B-v1.5、Yi-1.5-6B-Chat上测试真实道德困境数据集，目标框架推理准确率稳定提升，TriviaQA、GSM8K等通用能力无明显下降；人类评估、额外道德对（功利主义vs正义）测试、DailyDilemmas基准测试均验证方法有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第3节核心方法设计、图1的干预效果示意图、附录D的通用能力退化测试，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing inference-time moral preference control methods for LLMs, including prompt engineering and steering vectors with unbounded coefficients, lack interpretability and produce unpredictable effects, and cannot support fine-grained switching of ethical reasoning frameworks without compromising general capabilities.
summary_en.importance: It verifies the existence of divergent branch points for different ethical frameworks inside Transformers, providing insights for alignment research to directly locate internal representation pathways instead of full model fine-tuning. The proposed bounded preference weight calibration method can also improve the stability of existing steering vector solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Convergent-Divergent Routing (CDR). First, it locates branch points in Transformer blocks where attention heads are shared between utilitarianism and deontology but feed-forward network units diverge, and gates non-target paths to realize binary control. Then it adapts Common Spatial Patterns from EEG signal processing to extract discriminative directions corresponding to the two frameworks per layer, combined with Dual Logit Calibration to achieve fine-grained control using preference weights in the [0,1] range. No fine-tuning is required, only internal state modification during inference.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on real-world moral dilemma datasets across LLaMA-2-7B-Chat, Vicuna-7B-v1.5 and Yi-1.5-6B-Chat. Target framework reasoning accuracy improves consistently, no significant degradation is observed on general capability benchmarks including TriviaQA and GSM8K. Effectiveness is further validated by human evaluation, additional ethical pair (utilitarianism vs justice) tests and DailyDilemmas benchmark results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for core method design, Figure 1 for intervention effect demonstration, and Appendix D for general capability degradation tests. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看方法和消融即可；若 branch-point 定位稳定，能补上 activation steering 过于全局的短板。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations; if the branch-point localization is stable, it patches a real weakness of global activation steering.

paper.title: Minimizing Collateral Damage in Activation Steering
paper.abstract: Activation steering is a method for controlling Large Language Model (LLM) behavior by intervening in its internal representations to increase the alignment with a specific target feature direction. However, standard interventions, such as vector addition, often cause ``collateral damage", defined as unintended changes in the alignment of activations along other non-target feature directions. This damage occurs because standard methods implicitly assume the isotropy of non-target features. In th

summary.core_problem: 现有激活导向方法在控制LLM行为时，隐含假设非目标特征空间各向同性，容易对非目标特征的激活对齐造成非预期改动（附带损伤），导致导向效果和下游性能存在明确trade-off。
summary.importance: 明确了激活导向附带损伤的几何根源，为不损失模型原有性能的推理侧对齐方法提供了设计思路，也可用于预训练后轻量化对齐方案的效果验证。
summary.technical_approach: 将激活导向建模为带约束的优化问题，以固定目标方向余弦相似度为约束，最小化非目标方向的加权预期激活偏移（权重为激活的经验二阶矩矩阵，适配特征空间各向异性）。提出COAST方法，基于微分几何求解最优激活偏移，泛化了SLERP等现有保范数导向方法，各向同性条件下可退化为SLERP。
summary.experiments: 在Gemma-2-9B-IT上测试，相同导向成功率下，COAST相比ActAdd准确率最高提升20%；相同下游性能下，相比Angular Steering导向成功率最高提升30%，推理开销仅增加0.9%~4%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节优化目标的形式化推导、第4节的对比实验结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。对激活几何、推理侧对齐感兴趣的研究者可进一步查看附录的收敛性证明。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing activation steering methods for LLM behavior control implicitly assume isotropy of non-target feature spaces, leading to unintended alignment shifts of non-target activations (collateral damage), which creates a clear trade-off between steering effectiveness and downstream task performance.
summary_en.importance: It identifies the geometric root cause of collateral damage in activation steering, provides design principles for inference-time alignment methods that preserve original model performance, and can be used to verify the effect of lightweight post-pretrain alignment solutions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Activation steering is formalized as a constrained optimization problem. With a fixed cosine similarity constraint to the target direction, the method minimizes weighted expected activation shift across non-target directions, where weights are the empirical second-moment matrix of activations to adapt to the anisotropic feature space. The proposed COAST framework solves the optimal activation shift via differential geometry methods, generalizing existing norm-preserving steering methods like SLERP, and reduces to SLERP under isotropic conditions.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on Gemma-2-9B-IT, COAST achieves up to 20% higher accuracy than ActAdd under the same steering success rate, and up to 30% higher steering success rate than Angular Steering under the same downstream performance, with only 0.9%~4% additional inference overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for formal derivation of the optimization objective and Section 4 for comparative experimental results. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes. Researchers interested in activation geometry and inference-time alignment can further read the convergence proof in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 读数学设定和消融即可；它把 steering 的“副作用”从经验现象变成可优化量，值得复现一层。
recommendation.en: Read the formulation and ablations; it turns steering side effects into an optimizable quantity, worth a small internal replication.

However, we observe that LLMs exhibit systematic position biases during generation. Through extensive experiments with 10 LLMs and 5 vision-language models (VLMs) on three MCQ generation tasks, we show that these biases are structured, with similar patterns emerging within model families. To investigate the underlying mecha

summary.core_problem: LLM生成选择题时存在系统性位置偏差，正确答案分布不均，现有研究未揭示该偏差的底层机制
summary.importance: 机制分析，首次发现问题题干的隐表示中编码了正确答案位置的预测信号，说明LLM生成时会隐式规划答案位置
summary.technical_approach: 通过探测实验分析隐表示中的位置信号，使用激活操纵技术调整内部表示以干预答案位置分布
summary.experiments: 在10个LLM和5个VLM的3个选择题生成任务上验证偏差的存在，同模型家族偏差模式相似，激活操纵可显著改变答案位置分布
summary.authors_note: 香港理工大学、香港中文大学联合产出

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs exhibit systematic position bias when generating multiple-choice questions (MCQs), leading to uneven correct answer distribution, and the underlying mechanism of this bias remains unrevealed
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis, first discovered that hidden representations of question stems encode predictive signals of correct answer positions, indicating LLMs implicitly plan answer positions during generation
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyze position signals in hidden representations via probing experiments, use activation steering to adjust internal representations and intervene in answer position distribution
summary_en.experiments: Validate the existence of bias across 3 MCQ generation tasks on 10 LLMs and 5 VLMs, similar bias patterns exist within the same model family, activation steering can significantly shift answer position distribution
summary_en.authors_note: Joint work by The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and The Chinese University of Hong Kong

recommendation.zh: 仅验证了LLM生成选择题的位置偏差，作为bias分析的常见案例，备查即可不用读正文
recommendation.en: Only verifies the position bias of LLM-generated multiple-choice questions, serves as a common bias analysis case for reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Prefill-Time Intervention for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual-textual understanding, yet their reliability is critically undermined by hallucinations, i.e., the generation of factually incorrect or inconsistent responses. While recent studies using steering vectors demonstrated promise in reducing hallucinations, a notable challenge remains: they inadvertently amplify the severity of residual hallucinations. We attribute this to their exclusive focus on the decoding stage, whe

summary.core_problem: LVLM 幻觉缓解里，为什么很多 decoding-time steering（DTI）虽然降低幻觉频率，却会让剩余幻觉更“严重”、更容易滚雪球；以及能否在不改参数的前提下，从源头阻断这种自回归误差累积。论文把关键矛盾定位在干预时机与对象：在 decoding 阶段持续加 steering，往往是在错误表征已经形成后被动补救，且对多模态对齐与细粒度视觉证据不够敏感。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的相关性偏低到中等：它是推理期的可插拔干预方法，不涉及预训练目标/数据/优化。但它对“训练动态/表征”有一个可迁移的观点：KV cache 不是被动缓存，而是决定后续生成轨迹的初始状态；如果幻觉来自早期多模态表征偏置，那么在 prefill 阶段一次性把注意力的 key/value 分布拉回到更 grounded 的区域，可能比 decoding 阶段反复纠偏更稳定。这类思路也可能反哺到训练侧（例如把 cache-level 约束做成训练正则或蒸馏目标）。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI)：只在 prefill 阶段干预一次，直接修改初始 KV cache，而不是在 decoding 阶段对 hidden state 持续加 steering。
设计原则对应 DTI 的三类问题：
- when：从 reactive decoding 改为 proactive prefill，一次性塑形初始状态，减少后续自回归误差累积。
- how：modality-aware，区分视觉与文本的敏感性，不用“只从文本态导出的统一 steering 向量”。
- what：从粗粒度 hidden state 转向细粒度 KV cache，直接作用于注意力机制；并利用 K（决定 attend 到哪里）与 V（决定聚合什么信息）的角色差异做解耦控制。
具体做法上，论文使用 object-vs-background 的对比来构造方向：用向量把 key 推向更 object-centric 的注意力分配，同时让 value 更像是过滤背景噪声后的表征，从而得到更 grounded 的初始 cache。之后正常解码，不再持续干预。论文还强调 PTI 与现有 DTI 正交，可叠加。
summary.experiments: 在三种架构不同的 LVLM 上验证：LLaVA-1.5、Qwen-VL-Chat、DeepSeek-VL-Chat；在“object hallucination”与更综合的基准上优于既有 decoding-time 方法，并声称能缓解“降低频率但加重残余幻觉”的两难。当前给出的全文片段未包含具体基准名称、指标定义与数值表，也未展示与 VISTA 等方法的逐项对比数字、以及 PTI+DTI 叠加的增益幅度；需要在实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言与方法开头对“snowball hallucination”成因的拆解：为什么持续 decoding steering 可能放大残余错误。
- 重点看 PTI 如何从多模态 cache 导出方向，以及 K/V 解耦的实现细节（在哪些层做、是否对视觉 token 子序列单独处理、强度系数如何设）。
- 再看与 DTI 的可叠加实验：这部分决定它是否只是另一个 steering trick，还是更通用的干预点。
预计阅读时间：15–25 分钟理解方法；若要落地到推理栈，额外 30 分钟看实现与超参。

summary_en.core_problem: Decoding-time steering for hallucination mitigation in LVLMs often reduces hallucination frequency but worsens the severity of remaining errors via autoregressive “snowballing”. The paper asks whether a single, proactive intervention can prevent error accumulation at the source without changing model parameters.
summary_en.importance: Low-to-moderate relevance for pretraining-focused work: it is an inference-time, plug-and-play control method rather than a new pretraining recipe. The transferable insight is representation-centric: the prefill KV cache is an initial condition that shapes the entire generation trajectory. If hallucinations are seeded by early multimodal misalignment, intervening once at cache construction can be more stable than repeatedly correcting during decoding. This could inspire training-side objectives (e.g., cache-level regularization/distillation), though the paper itself stays at inference.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI): intervene only once during prefill by directly modifying the initial KV cache, instead of applying a uniform steering vector to hidden states throughout decoding.
It is designed around three axes:
- When: proactive prefill intervention to stop error accumulation before it starts.
- How: modality-aware steering, avoiding text-only, modality-agnostic directions.
- What: target fine-grained KV cache rather than coarse hidden states; exploit the functional split between keys (where to attend) and values (what content to aggregate).
Concretely, PTI derives steering directions using object-vs-background contrasts: steer keys toward object-grounded attention and steer values to suppress background noise, producing a better-grounded cache for subsequent normal decoding. PTI is claimed to be orthogonal to existing decoding-time methods and can be combined with them.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three LVLMs with different architectures: LLaVA-1.5, Qwen-VL-Chat, and DeepSeek-VL-Chat. The paper reports improvements on object-hallucination and broader hallucination benchmarks, outperforming prior decoding-time interventions, and claims better control of residual hallucination severity. The provided excerpt does not include the exact benchmark names, metrics, or numeric tables, nor the magnitude of gains for PTI+DTI combinations; these need verification in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the motivation around “snowball hallucinations” and why continuous decoding-time steering can backfire.
- Focus on how PTI computes cache-level directions from multimodal signals and how K/V are modified (layers, token ranges, strength hyperparameters).
- Check the add-on experiments combining PTI with existing DTI methods; this determines whether PTI is a generally useful intervention point.
Time: ~15–25 minutes for the core idea; add ~30 minutes for implementation details if integrating into an inference stack.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和方法图就够；有用信号是 hallucination 干预点应看 prefill KV，而不只看 decoding logits。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and method figure; the useful signal is to inspect prefill KV states, not only decoding-time logits, when studying LVLM hallucination.

paper.title: Contextual Linear Activation Steering of Language Models
paper.abstract: Linear activation steering is a powerful approach for eliciting the capabilities of large language models and specializing their behavior using limited labeled data. While effective, existing methods often apply a fixed steering strength to all tokens, resulting in inconsistent steering quality across diverse input prompts. In this work, we introduce Contextual Linear Activation Steering (CLAS), a method that dynamically adapts linear activation steering to context-dependent steering strengths.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 activation steering 里一个很实际但长期被忽略的问题：传统 LAS 用单一固定系数 α 对所有 prompt、所有 token、往往甚至所有层统一加同样强度的 steering direction，因此在输入分布变化时很容易出现 under-steering 或 over-steering。论文要解决的不是“如何找到一个更好的全局 α”，而是“能不能让 steering 强度随上下文和层位动态变化，同时保留线性 steering 的可解释性和低样本优势”。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于替代预训练，而在于提供了一个更干净的接口去研究“概念方向是否真是线性的、何时该激活、在哪些层激活”。它把原来需要人工或 evaluator 网格搜索的 inference-time 超参选择，改成了一个用少量 prompt-completion 数据、直接优化 next-token loss 的轻量学习问题。这个改动很小，但意义明确：一方面让 steering 更稳定、更可部署；另一方面把 probe-based interpretability 和 PEFT 式行为编辑连接起来，说明很多行为控制问题未必需要 LoRA/ReFT 这类更重的参数更新。对做训练动态、表示线性化、mechanistic interpretability 的人，这篇文章提供了一个值得继续扩展的中间层方法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把固定系数 LAS 改成 context-dependent coefficient。标准 LAS 在第 ℓ 层第 t 个位置做的是 h~_{ℓ,t}=h_{ℓ,t}+α d_ℓ，其中 d_ℓ 是从 probe 提取的单位 steering vector，α 是手调常数。CLAS 改成 h~_{ℓ,t}=h_{ℓ,t}+(c_ℓ·[h_{ℓ,t};1]) d_ℓ，也就是用一个线性 sensing vector c_ℓ 读取当前激活 h_{ℓ,t}，输出该 token、该层的局部 steering 强度。这里 [h;1] 里的常数 1 相当于给 gating 加偏置项。

整个流程分两步。第一步，先像以往 probe-based steering 一样，为每一层训练概念 probe，并从 probe 中抽取 steering direction d_ℓ。第二步，固定这些 d_ℓ，只学习 sensing vector c_ℓ。训练目标不是外部 evaluator 打分，而是小规模 prompt-completion 数据上的标准 next-token prediction loss。这样做有几个关键取舍：
1. 保留了 steering direction 的可解释性，因为真正承载“概念”的仍是 probe 提取的 d_ℓ；
2. 把自由度限制在线性 gating 上，而不是直接更新大批模型参数，因此样本效率和训练成本都更可控；
3. 相比 ReFT/LoRA，CLAS 的参数量更小，且结构上更接近“读出概念并按需施加”，而不是在残差空间里学习一个低秩补丁。

论文还把 CLAS 与 ReFT、LoRA 做了一个有意思的统一比较：不仅比较 steering 效果，也比较这些方法学到的方向能否反过来做 concept monitoring。结果显示 ReFT/LoRA 的低秩方向也含有一定概念信息，但 probe-derived directions 明显更适合解释和监测，这一点支撑了 CLAS 的设计选择。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 11 个 steering 任务、4 个 instruction-tuned 模型家族。任务类型包括 step-by-step reasoning、multilingual translation、tldr 风格摘要等，设定是不给显式指令，只给少量 completion 数据，让模型学会朝目标行为偏转。论文的主结论比较稳定：
1. 相比标准 LAS，CLAS 在几乎所有 model-task 组合上都更好，且不需要为每个任务做昂贵的 α 网格搜索；
2. 在 limited labeled data 场景下，CLAS 的效果与 ReFT、LoRA 持平或更好；
3. 调参速度上，CLAS 明显快于需要训练低秩适配器的方案，因为它只学每层一个 sensing vector；
4. 在 concept monitoring 实验里，CLAS 使用的 probe 方向在 11 个监测任务上的线性可读性高于 ReFT/LoRA 学到的方向，说明后两者虽然能改行为，但表示更“缠绕”。

从全文给出的实验组织看，作者还专门测了任务间干扰：把模型朝某一行为 steering 后，再看其他任务性能是否受损。这部分很重要，因为它关系到 steering 是否只是粗暴地改写整体分布。论文结论是 CLAS 的干扰可控，通常优于固定强度 LAS。摘要里没有完整数字，全文重点是相对趋势和跨任务一致性，而不是单一 benchmark 的极限分数。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但方法部分值得认真看。建议顺序是：
1. 先看 Introduction 前两页，抓住它要解决的不是“找更强方向”，而是“让方向按上下文激活”；
2. 再看 Method 里 CLAS 的公式和训练流程，重点理解为什么只学习 c_ℓ 而固定 d_ℓ，这决定了它与 LoRA/ReFT 的边界；
3. 结果部分优先看 11 个 steering 任务的主表，以及任务干扰实验；
4. 如果关心可解释性，重点看 concept monitoring 那一节，那里是全文最有研究味道的部分。

预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主要内容。值得深挖的点有三个：第一，c_ℓ·h 这种线性 gating 是否已经足够，还是更高阶 gating 才能覆盖复杂行为；第二，probe direction 在不同层的稳定性如何，是否能迁移到未见任务；第三，这种方法能否从 inference-time steering 进一步走向 pretrain-time representation shaping。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical weakness of linear activation steering: standard LAS applies a single global steering coefficient to every prompt, token, and often every layer, which makes steering brittle across heterogeneous contexts. The real problem is not finding a better fixed alpha, but learning when and where a steering direction should be activated while preserving the simplicity and interpretability of probe-based steering.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is indirect but real. CLAS turns steering-strength selection from an expensive evaluator-driven hyperparameter search into a small next-token-loss optimization problem. That matters because it creates a cleaner bridge between mechanistic interpretability and lightweight behavior control. It also suggests that some behavior specialization tasks do not require heavier PEFT methods such as LoRA or ReFT if the relevant concept direction is already linearly encoded and only needs context-sensitive gating. For researchers working on representation geometry, concept linearity, or controllable adaptation, this is a useful design point.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和与 LoRA/ReFT 的少样本对比；若结果干净，它会改变“线性 steering 只能做粗糙控制”的先验。
recommendation.en: Read the method and the small-data comparison with LoRA/ReFT; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that linear steering is only a crude control knob.

institutions: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

paper.title: Breaking Bad: Interpretability-Based Safety Audits of State-of-the-Art LLMs
paper.abstract: Effective safety auditing of large language models (LLMs) demands tools that go beyond black-box probing and systematically uncover vulnerabilities rooted in model internals. We present a comprehensive, interpretability-driven jailbreaking audit of eight SOTA open-source LLMs: Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B-4bt, GPT-oss- 20B, GPT-oss-120B, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-32B, Phi4-3.8B, and Phi4-14B. Leveraging interpretability-based approaches -- Universal Steering (US) and Representation Engineering (RepE) --

summary.core_problem: 评估最强开源 LLM 在基于可解释性激活操控的 jailbreak 审计下有多脆弱，以及不同模型家族的内部表示是否更容易被“转向”到不安全行为。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是安全审计与机制分析：不是提出新的预训练方法，而是把 Universal Steering 和 RepE 用于系统化越狱测试，给出不同模型家族在内部表示层面的脆弱性差异。这对 pretrain 研究员的价值在于理解“安全性是否部分写在表示几何里”。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用两类 interpretability-based 攻击：Universal Steering 和 Representation Engineering，并设计两阶段自适应网格搜索来寻找最优 steering coefficient；在统一有害问题集和 LLM judge 协议下，对 8 个开源模型做白盒式安全审计。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B-4bt、GPT-oss-20B、GPT-oss-120B、Qwen3-0.6B、Qwen3-32B、Phi4-3.8B、Phi4-14B。结果显示 Llama-3 系列在这类激活操控下明显更脆弱，Llama-3.3-70B-4bt 的 jailbreak rate 可达 91%（US）和 83%（RepE）；GPT-oss-120B 对两类攻击都更稳健。摘要未给出更细的层位、概念方向或 judge 偏差分析，因此结论更适合作为模型间对比信号，而不是定论。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 SRI 的 NuSCI Research Group / Computer Science Laboratory。Susmit Jha 在安全、可靠性和形式化方向较有代表性；这篇工作更像安全机制审计，而非基础模型训练论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how vulnerable state-of-the-art open LLMs are to interpretability-based jailbreaks, and whether some model families are intrinsically easier to steer toward unsafe behavior through internal representations.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a safety-audit and mechanism-analysis contribution rather than a pretraining method. Its value for pretraining researchers is that it probes whether safety robustness is partly encoded in representation geometry, not just in surface-level refusal behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: It applies two interpretability-based attack families—Universal Steering and Representation Engineering—and introduces a two-stage adaptive grid search to tune steering coefficients. Eight open models are audited under a curated harmful-query set and a standardized LLM-judge protocol.
summary_en.experiments: Models include Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.3-70B-4bt, GPT-oss-20B, GPT-oss-120B, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-32B, Phi4-3.8B, and Phi4-14B. Llama-3 models appear substantially more vulnerable, with Llama-3.3-70B-4bt reaching 91% jailbreak success under US and 83% under RepE, while GPT-oss-120B remains comparatively robust. The abstract does not expose enough detail on layer choice, concept construction, or judge sensitivity, so the results should be treated as directional rather than final.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from SRI’s NuSCI Research Group / Computer Science Laboratory. Susmit Jha is known for security and reliability work; this paper is best framed as a safety/mechanistic audit rather than a foundation-model training contribution.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练不直接相连，但“不同家族对表示操控的脆弱性差很多”这个现象值得记；只看结果表和攻击设定，别把 judge 分数当硬结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the cross-family gap in vulnerability to representation steering is worth noting; read the setup and result tables, and treat the LLM-judge outputs as soft evidence.

paper.title: FineSteer: A Unified Framework for Fine-Grained Inference-Time Steering in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit undesirable behaviors, such as safety violations and hallucinations. Although inference-time steering offers a cost-effective way to adjust model behavior without updating its parameters, existing methods often fail to be simultaneously effective, utility-preserving, and training-efficient due to their rigid, one-size-fits-all designs and limited adaptability. In this work, we present FineSteer, a novel steering framework that decomposes inference-time

summary.core_problem: 解决推理时 steering 方法难以同时做到有效、保留原有能力、且适应不同查询的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个统一 inference-time steering 框架，贡献类型属于方法整合与细粒度控制设计，对后训练和可控生成有参考价值，但对预训练方法论的直接推动有限。
summary.technical_approach: FineSteer 将 steering 拆成两阶段：先用 Subspace-guided Conditional Steering 判断何时需要施加干预，避免无谓修改内部表征；再用 Mixture-of-Steering-Experts 为不同查询合成细粒度 steering vector，以适配多模态的目标行为分布。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法面向安全与幻觉等行为控制任务，强调在 effectiveness、utility preservation 和 training efficiency 上优于现有方法；但未给出模型规模、数据规模、具体基线和提升幅度，因此目前更像一篇值得快速浏览方法设计的工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the difficulty of making inference-time steering simultaneously effective, utility-preserving, and adaptive to different queries.
summary_en.importance: This is a unified steering framework with fine-grained control. Its contribution is mainly methodological for controllable generation and post-training, with limited direct impact on pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: FineSteer decomposes steering into two stages: Subspace-guided Conditional Steering decides when steering is needed to avoid unnecessary intervention, and Mixture-of-Steering-Experts synthesizes query-specific steering vectors to capture multimodal desired behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method on safety and hallucination control, claiming gains in effectiveness, utility preservation, and training efficiency over prior steering methods. However, it does not provide model sizes, dataset scales, baselines, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 这是后训练控制层的小框架，不会改变你对基座训练的 prior；若做 activation steering，只看 conditional gating 和 expert synthesis 两个部件是否真比单向量干净。
recommendation.en: This is a control-layer paper, not a foundation-training shift; if you care about activation steering, just inspect whether the conditional gating and expert synthesis are actually cleaner than single-vector baselines.

paper.title: From Weights to Activations: Is Steering the Next Frontier of Adaptation?

summary.core_problem: 如何把“推理时激活干预(steering)”与微调/提示等传统适配方法放到同一框架下理解，并明确其作为一种“模型适配”的边界与能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏概念框架与综述式分析：提出适配方法的功能性判据，用于系统比较 steering 与参数更新/输入操控方法；对后续研究（可逆、局部、无参数适配）提供统一术语与分类，有助于把零/少训练的行为控制纳入可分析对象。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一组“适配(adaptation)”的功能标准/判据（如目标行为改变、局部性、可逆性、是否需要参数更新、干预粒度等），据此对多类 steering 方法（激活向量注入、方向编辑、层级干预等）与微调、PEFT、prompting 做对照分析，给出 steering 作为“激活空间干预式适配”的定位与分类学建议。
summary.experiments: 以概念分析与方法学比较为主；摘要未体现新的大规模实证或SOTA结果（更像统一框架/立场论文而非提出新算法）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to place inference-time activation interventions (“steering”) into the same conceptual framework as fine-tuning/PEFT/prompting, clarifying its scope and capabilities as a form of model adaptation.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a conceptual/taxonomy contribution: proposes functional criteria for adaptation methods to systematically compare steering with parameter-update and input-based approaches; helps formalize reversible, local, no-weight-update behavior control as a first-class adaptation paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces functional adaptation criteria (e.g., targeted behavioral change, locality, reversibility, need for weight updates, intervention granularity) and uses them to contrast steering methods (activation-space interventions) with fine-tuning, PEFT, and prompting, motivating a unified taxonomy.
summary_en.experiments: Mainly conceptual analysis and comparative framing; the abstract does not indicate new large-scale empirical results or SOTA claims.

recommendation.zh: 偏术语与框架统一：快速扫分类表/判据就够，用来把 steering 放进你们内部的适配对照实验矩阵里，正文论证不必逐段抠。
recommendation.en: Mostly taxonomy and criteria: skim the comparison tables/definitions, then use it to structure your internal adaptation ablations; the narrative argument isn’t worth line-by-line reading.

paper.title: Compiling Activation Steering into Weights via Null-Space Constraints for Stealthy Backdoors

summary.core_problem: 如何将“激活层面的steering/越狱行为”稳定地编译进LLM权重中，形成更隐蔽且更可靠的供应链后门，而非只诱导表层token前缀。
summary.importance: 安全与对齐视角的重要方法型工作：揭示仅做token级目标会导致后门输出不稳定，并提出将行为差异对齐到内部表征的权重编辑范式；对理解/防御权重编辑与对齐鲁棒性有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 先从“服从 vs 拒绝”行为中提取steering vector（内部表征差异方向），再通过带有null-space约束的权重更新，将触发器映射到该表征方向，从而在多步解码中持续维持攻击者期望的行为（而非只保证首token）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据；报告相较现有后门/权重编辑方法，能显著提升触发后输出的持续性与可靠性，同时保持常规评测下的隐蔽性（正常行为不显著退化）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to reliably compile activation-level steering (jailbreak behavior) into LLM weights to create stealthy, durable supply-chain backdoors, beyond shallow token-prefix objectives.
summary_en.importance: A method-centric safety/alignment contribution: shows token-level backdoor objectives can be unreliable across decoding steps, and proposes an internal-representation-aligned weight-editing paradigm with implications for robustness and defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: Extract a steering vector capturing the representation difference between compliant vs refusal behaviors, then perform weight updates with null-space constraints so that a hidden trigger induces movement along this internal direction, sustaining harmful behavior over multiple decoding steps.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes/datasets; it claims substantially improved multi-step backdoor reliability while remaining stealthy under standard evaluations (minimal degradation on benign behavior).

recommendation.zh: 只看方法与消融：把 steering 用零空间约束“写进权重”这招很可复现，也提醒我们别再把前缀触发当可靠后门基线。
recommendation.en: Skim the method + ablations: null-space constraints make “steering-into-weights” fairly reproducible, and it’s a good reminder that prefix-trigger backdoor baselines are too brittle.

paper.title: Steered LLM Activations are Non-Surjective

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦一个常被忽略但很基础的问题：白盒“激活引导/激活转向（activation steering）”得到的中间激活状态，是否一定能被某个纯文本prompt在模型自然前向传播中“复现”？作者将其形式化为“从离散prompt到内部激活的映射是否满射（surjective）”的问题，并主张典型的steering会把残差流推到prompt不可达的区域，因此几乎不存在能精确复现该steered激活的prompt。
summary.importance: 该结论直接影响安全与可解释性研究中对steering演示的解读：白盒条件下通过加向量绕过拒答/诱发不安全行为，并不自动意味着黑盒（仅prompt）也存在同等级别的可利用风险。更广泛地，它提醒研究者区分“内部可控性（white-box controllability）”与“文本可达性（black-box reachability）”，避免把steering当作“发现了prompt可触达的新行为模式”。
summary.technical_approach:
must_read级别（详细技术分析）：
1) 形式化：固定一个Transformer与层/位置的表示（重点是残差流），定义从离散prompt集合S=V^{<=K}到激活空间R\subseteqR^d的映射F（自然前向传播产生的表示）。Steering被建模为对某层/位置表示做加性扰动：r' = r + \alpha v（v为方向，\alpha为强度）。问题变为：给定r'，是否存在某个prompt s使得F(s)=r'？即r'是否在Im(F)。
2) 关键理论支撑：作者借用并扩展Nikolaou et al. (2025)关于“LLM几乎处处注入（injective）”的结论：不同prompt几乎必然对应不同内部状态。结合prompt空间是离散/可数（有限上下文K时甚至有限），而激活空间是连续高维，Im(F)在连续空间中是“极稀疏”的可达集合。
3) 非满射结论直觉：steering在连续空间里沿任意方向做平移，几乎必然把点移出Im(F)。更强的说法是：在实践假设下（例如方向v与可达集合的几何结构不发生测度为正的特殊对齐），对随机/一般选择的v与\alpha，r+\alpha v落在Im(F)的概率为0（almost surely）。因此“精确prompt复现steered激活”几乎不可能。
4) 含义澄清：该结论针对“精确复现同一内部激活状态”。它不否认prompt可能在输出层面近似模仿某些行为，也不否认存在极少数特殊steering可能恰好落在可达集合上；但从测度/概率意义上，steering通常产生prompt不可达的内部状态。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在多个开源模型上做了经验验证：将白盒steering得到的激活轨迹作为目标，尝试用仅prompt的方式去“复刻”相同（或极接近）的内部表示/轨迹，发现存在稳定的差距：黑盒prompt搜索难以达到steered激活附近，从而支持“steering把残差流推离prompt可达流形/集合”的主张。实验还用于支撑威胁模型结论：白盒可控≠黑盒可攻。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议：重点章节/图表/创新点）：
- 重点读Introduction中对“surjectivity视角”的问题重述，以及对安全含义（white-box vs black-box）的界定。
- 精读Notation & Background：把prompt集合、层/位置表示、残差流干预的数学对象对齐；理解作者如何把Nikolaou(2025)的注入性结果转化为“可达集合稀疏/非满射”的论证。
- 重点看主定理/证明所在章节（文中提到§4）：关注“practical assumptions”具体是什么、以及“almost surely”的概率空间如何定义（对prompt？对steering方向？对参数？）。
- 图表：优先看Figure 1（steering轨迹 vs prompt可达集合的示意）以及任何展示“prompt-only replication失败/距离分布”的实验图。
- 创新点抓手：把steering可达性从经验争论提升为严格的映射性质（满射性）问题；并给出与安全评估协议相关的解释框架。

skim（泛读建议）：
- 只读Introduction + 贡献点列表，抓住核心结论：steered激活通常无prompt原像。
- 快速扫Notation定义，知道他们研究对象是残差流表示与加性steering。
- 直接看实验结论段与关键图（Figure 1及复现失败的结果图），理解“白盒演示不等于黑盒风险”的主要论点即可。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心提醒是方法论层面的：activation steering是一种“特权通道”的控制手段，它展示的是在表示空间里外力注入能做到什么，而不是prompt空间里用户能触达什么。因而在用steering做安全论证或可解释性推断时，应显式区分可控性与可达性，并在评估中按威胁模型分层。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a foundational question behind activation steering: are the steered internal activation states realizable by *any* purely textual prompt under the model’s natural forward pass? The authors formalize this as a surjectivity question for the mapping from discrete prompts to internal activations, and argue that steering typically moves the residual stream to states that are not prompt-reachable—so an exact prompt preimage almost surely does not exist.
summary_en.importance: This matters for both safety and interpretability. White-box steering demonstrations (e.g., toggling refusal with a single vector) are often taken as evidence of brittle alignment, but the paper argues such results do not automatically translate to black-box (prompt-only) exploitability. More broadly, it urges evaluations to separate *white-box controllability* from *black-box reachability*.
summary_en.technical_approach:
must_read (detailed technical analysis):
1) Formalization: Fix a Transformer and a target layer/position representation (primarily the residual stream). Define the natural mapping F from the discrete prompt set S=V^{<=K} to an activation space R\subseteqR^d. Steering is modeled as an additive intervention r' = r + \alpha v. The question becomes whether r' lies in Im(F), i.e., whether there exists a prompt s such that F(s)=r'.
2) Key theoretical ingredient: building on (and extending) Nikolaou et al. (2025), which shows LLM internal states are almost surely injective across distinct prompts. Combined with the fact that the prompt domain is discrete/countable (finite when K is finite) while the activation space is continuous and high-dimensional, the reachable set Im(F) is extremely sparse inside R^d.
3) Non-surjectivity intuition and claim: an additive shift along a generic direction v will almost surely push r outside Im(F). Under practical assumptions (informally, no measure-positive special alignment between v and the reachable set’s geometry), the probability that r+\alpha v is exactly prompt-reachable is 0 (almost surely). Hence exact prompt replication of steered activations is typically impossible.
4) Scope: the claim is about *exact internal-state reproduction*. It does not rule out output-level behavioral imitation by prompts, nor rare special cases where a steered point happens to be reachable; the statement is measure/probability-theoretic and generic.
summary_en.experiments: Empirically, the authors test multiple open-weight models by taking white-box steered activation trajectories as targets and attempting prompt-only replication (searching for prompts that match the internal states/trajectories). They observe a consistent gap: black-box prompting fails to reach the steered states closely, supporting the “off-manifold/off-reachable-set” claim. The experiments also reinforce the threat-model takeaway: white-box bypasses do not imply comparable black-box vulnerabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading):
- Introduction: focus on the surjectivity framing and the safety interpretation (white-box vs black-box).
- Notation & Background: align the objects (prompt set, layer/position representations, residual stream, additive steering) and see how injectivity is leveraged toward non-surjectivity.
- Main theorem/proof section (referred to as §4): identify the exact “practical assumptions” and what the “almost surely” probability space is over (steering directions, prompts, parameters, etc.).
- Figures: prioritize Figure 1 (conceptual geometry) and the key experimental plots showing prompt-only replication failure / distance distributions.
- Innovation to track: elevating steering reachability into a precise mapping-property (surjectivity) question, and tying it to threat-model-aware evaluation.

skim (quick pass):
- Read Introduction + contributions for the main claim.
- Skim the formal definitions to understand it’s about residual-stream additive interventions.
- Jump to the main experimental results and Figure 1 to internalize the practical implication: steering ≠ prompt-reachable behavior.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s methodological message is that activation steering is a privileged, white-box control channel: it shows what can be achieved by injecting signals directly into representation space, not what users can reach via text. Therefore, safety and interpretability conclusions drawn from steering should explicitly account for reachability under the intended threat model.

recommendation.zh: 它把steering的“白盒可控”与“prompt可达”硬切开：很多被推到文本不可达激活区，安全外推要更谨慎；看形式化定义与关键反例即可。
recommendation.en: Useful for separating white-box controllability from black-box reachability: steering often lands in prompt-unreachable activation regions, so safety extrapolations are overstated; skim the formalization and the core counterexamples.

paper.title: Dictionary-Aligned Concept Control for Safeguarding Multimodal LLMs

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型（MLLM）在面对文本 jailbreak 与图像对抗（如排版触发、反事实语义、不可感知扰动）时容易输出有害/违规内容。现有安全方案（提示词、响应过滤、微调）分别存在脆弱、需要重复调用、或成本高的问题。激活（表示）steering 虽然灵活，但现有方法要么概念集合太小、要么强度难校准、要么 SAE 特征缺乏语义落地导致难以精确控制某个安全概念而不伤及其他能力。论文要解决的是：在冻结模型参数的前提下，实现“可扩展、可标注、可精细解耦”的多概念安全控制。
summary.importance: DACO 把“概念词典（可解释、可扩展）”与“稀疏自编码器 SAE（可组合、可控）”结合，试图同时解决覆盖面、可控性与可解释性三难：用大规模概念库支撑更丰富的激活基底学习，并把 SAE 原子自动对齐到词典概念与安全标签，从而在推理时以较低开销对冻结 MLLM 做细粒度安全 steering，且尽量保持通用效用。这类方法对快速应对新型攻击模式、跨模型迁移（QwenVL/LLaVA/InternVL）具有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
（must_read 级别：详细技术分析）
DACO 的核心是“词典对齐的稀疏分解 + 可标注的 SAE 原子 + 推理时系数级干预”。
1) 大规模概念词典构建（§3.1）：
- 从 WordNet 抽取 >15,000 个概念；
- 从 CC-3M 检索约 400,000 个 caption-image 对构建 DACO-400K；
- 将这些样本喂给目标 MLLM，收集指定层/位置的激活，并按概念聚合得到 concept vectors（概念向量）；
- 将概念划分为 desirable/undesirable（与安全任务相关的“应增强/应抑制”概念集合）。
关键点：相比以往 <20 个 steering 向量的做法，DACO 用数量级更大的概念覆盖来刻画激活空间几何结构，并为后续稀疏建模提供“字典”。
2) 基于词典的稀疏编码与概念移除（§3.2）：
- 将某层残差流激活表示为少量概念向量的线性组合（稀疏分解）；
- 通过抑制/移除 undesirable 概念对应的系数，实现对有害概念的定向压制；
- 该路径强调“训练开销低/可训练-free 或轻量”的控制，并提供一定语义可解释性（系数对应概念）。
3) 词典初始化与自动标注的 SAE（§3.3）：
- 训练 SAE 以学习更“表达力强”的稀疏基底（atoms），用于更好地覆盖激活空间；
- 用概念词典来初始化 SAE decoder（让 atoms 从一开始就贴近可解释概念方向，而不是纯数据驱动的不可名状特征）；
- 通过“最近邻概念向量”把 SAE atoms 自动注入语义标签与安全标签（undesirable/desirable），降低人工探针与解释成本。
4) 推理时 steering 机制：
- 在选定层对稀疏系数做干预：增强 desirable atoms 的系数、抑制 undesirable atoms 的系数；
- 目标是在不改参数的情况下提升安全性，同时尽量保持通用能力。
5) 相对现有方法的差异化：
- 相比对比提示得到的 steering vectors：DACO 覆盖更广、冗余更少，并通过稀疏性提升可组合控制；
- 相比纯 SAE：DACO 通过词典对齐解决“特征无语义锚点”的痛点，并支持自动标注与更可控的概念级调节；
- 相比过滤/微调：推理时一次前向即可干预，无需 rerun 或昂贵训练。
summary.experiments:
论文声称在多个基准（如 MM-SafetyBench、JailBreakV）与多个代表性 MLLM（QwenVL、LLaVA、InternVL）上验证：显著提升安全性，同时保持通用效用。精读时建议重点核对：
- 安全指标：攻击成功率/违规率下降幅度，是否覆盖文本+图像攻击类型；
- 效用保持：通用 VQA/对话基准是否掉点，掉点与 steering 强度的关系曲线；
- 可控性：是否展示“只抑制某类概念不影响其他概念”的解耦实验（概念干预的选择性/正交性）；
- 规模效应：概念数量（15k）与样本量（400k）对效果的边际收益；
- 消融：无词典初始化的 SAE、无 SAE 仅词典稀疏编码、不同层/不同干预位置的对比；
- 运行开销：推理时额外计算（稀疏编码/SAE 前向）与延迟。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）
- Figure 1/3（框架与流水线）：先把“词典→概念向量→稀疏分解→SAE 对齐→推理干预”的数据流与张量流走通。
- §3.1：概念抽取、DACO-400K 构建、激活聚合方式（在哪一层、如何池化、如何去噪/去歧义）决定词典质量。
- §3.2：稀疏编码目标函数、稀疏度约束、以及 undesirable 概念移除的具体算子（投影/截断/缩放）与强度标定。
- §3.3：SAE 结构、decoder 初始化细节、atoms 自动标注（最近邻度量、阈值、冲突处理）是“可解释+可控”的关键。
- §4：跨模型与跨基准泛化；重点看安全-效用 trade-off 曲线与消融表。

skim（泛读建议）
- 读 Introduction 把握三大痛点（概念少、强度难调、SAE 无语义）。
- 快速扫 §3：理解 DACO 的三步（大词典、稀疏分解、词典对齐 SAE）。
- 直接看 §4 主结果表与消融，确认是否“安全显著提升且效用基本不掉”。
summary.authors_note: 作者把 MLLM 安全 steering 的关键瓶颈归因于“概念覆盖不足”和“稀疏特征缺少语义锚点”。DACO 用大规模词典为激活空间提供可解释坐标系，并用词典初始化与自动标注把 SAE 的控制能力转化为可操作的安全概念旋钮，从而在冻结模型下实现更可扩展、更细粒度的安全控制。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal LLMs can be induced to produce harmful/policy-violating outputs via text jailbreaks and image-based adversarial inputs (typographic triggers, counterfactual semantics, imperceptible perturbations). Prompting, response filtering, and finetuning are respectively brittle, require reruns/extra compute, or are expensive. Activation steering is flexible but existing MLLM steering often covers too few concepts, is hard to calibrate, and SAE features lack semantic grounding—making it difficult to adjust one safety concept without collateral damage. The goal is scalable, semantically grounded, fine-grained safety control on frozen MLLMs at inference time.
summary_en.importance: DACO combines a curated concept dictionary (interpretable and scalable) with sparse autoencoders (compositional and controllable) to address coverage, controllability, and interpretability simultaneously. By aligning SAE atoms to dictionary concepts and safety labels, DACO enables low-overhead inference-time steering that improves safety while preserving general utility, and can transfer across models (QwenVL/LLaVA/InternVL) and evolving attack patterns.
summary_en.technical_approach:
(must_read: detailed technical analysis)
DACO = dictionary-aligned sparse decomposition + labelable SAE atoms + coefficient-level interventions.
1) Large concept dictionary construction (§3.1): extract >15k concepts from WordNet; retrieve ~400k caption-image pairs from CC-3M to form DACO-400K; run the target MLLM to collect activations and aggregate them into concept vectors; partition concepts into desirable vs undesirable for the safety task.
2) Dictionary-based sparse coding and concept removal (§3.2): represent a layer’s residual-stream activation as a sparse linear combination of concept vectors; suppress/remove coefficients associated with undesirable concepts to steer behavior, providing concept-level interpretability.
3) Dictionary-initialized and auto-annotated SAE (§3.3): train an SAE to learn a more expressive sparse basis; initialize the SAE decoder using the concept dictionary so atoms start near interpretable directions; automatically annotate atoms with semantic/safety labels via nearest-neighbor matching to concept vectors, reducing manual probing.
4) Inference-time steering: at selected layers, strengthen coefficients of desirable atoms and suppress undesirable ones, without changing model parameters.
5) Differentiation: broader and less entangled than contrastive steering vectors; more semantically grounded than vanilla SAEs; cheaper and single-pass compared to filtering/finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports substantial safety gains with preserved general-purpose utility on benchmarks such as MM-SafetyBench and JailBreakV across MLLMs including QwenVL, LLaVA, and InternVL. When reading results, verify: (i) safety improvements across both text- and image-driven attacks; (ii) utility retention on general VQA/chat tasks and safety–utility trade-off vs steering strength; (iii) selectivity/decoupling tests showing targeted concept suppression; (iv) scaling effects of 15k concepts and 400k samples; (v) ablations (no dictionary init, dictionary-only sparse coding, layer choices); and (vi) inference overhead/latency.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep reading)
- Figures 1 & 3: understand the full pipeline from dictionary → concept vectors → sparse coding → dictionary-aligned SAE → inference intervention.
- §3.1: concept extraction, DACO-400K construction, activation aggregation choices (layer/position/pooling) that determine dictionary quality.
- §3.2: sparse coding objective, sparsity constraints, the exact suppression operator and calibration.
- §3.3: SAE architecture, decoder initialization, and auto-annotation (distance metric/threshold/conflict handling).
- §4: cross-model and cross-benchmark generalization; focus on safety–utility curves and ablations.

skim (fast reading)
- Introduction for the three pain points (few concepts, hard calibration, ungrounded SAE features).
- Skim §3 for the three-step recipe (large dictionary, sparse decomposition, dictionary-aligned SAE).
- Jump to §4 main tables and ablations to confirm “large safety gains with minimal utility loss.”
summary_en.authors_note: The authors attribute key limitations of MLLM safety steering to insufficient concept coverage and the lack of semantic anchors in sparse features. DACO provides an interpretable coordinate system via a large concept dictionary and turns SAE control into actionable safety knobs through dictionary-based initialization and automatic atom labeling, enabling scalable, fine-grained inference-time control on frozen models.

recommendation.zh: 值得看其“词典对齐SAE”是否真能稳控强度且不伤通用：若成立，动作是把安全概念库做成可迁移的激活开关；但注意setup易被评测泄漏污染。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming to judge whether dictionary-aligned SAEs actually give stable, non-destructive control; if yes, the action is building a transferable concept-switch layer—watch for eval leakage/dirty setups.

paper.title: SHIFT: Steering Hidden Intermediates in Flow Transformers

summary.core_problem: 在不重训扩散模型的情况下，实现对DiT图像生成的概念移除/风格迁移/对象偏置等可控编辑，并尽量保持其余提示词内容与画质。
summary.importance: 方法迁移与工程实用：将LLM中的activation steering思想迁移到DiT扩散模型，通过推理期操控中间激活实现轻量控制；对生成模型安全（去除不想要概念）与可控生成具有直接价值。
summary.technical_approach: SHIFT：学习“steering vectors”，在推理时对选定层与扩散时间步的中间激活进行动态注入/偏置，从而抑制目标概念或引导到特定风格域/添加或替换对象；强调无需耗时重训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型/数据规模与定量评测细节；仅描述在多样prompt与目标上有效控制且保持质量。需查全文确认：使用的DiT/数据集（如ImageNet/LAION系）、与LoRA/文本反演/安全微调等baseline对比、以及概念移除成功率与保真度指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Enable controllable edits in Diffusion Transformers (e.g., concept removal, style transfer, object biasing) at inference time without retraining, while preserving other prompt content and image quality.
summary_en.importance: Transfers activation-steering ideas to diffusion/flow-based image generators, offering a lightweight and practical control mechanism with direct relevance to safety (concept suppression) and controllable generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SHIFT learns steering vectors that are injected as dynamic biases into selected intermediate activations at chosen layers and diffusion timesteps during inference, steering generation away from or toward target concepts/styles/objects without updating model parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Based on the provided summary, the abstract does not report concrete model/dataset details or quantitative metrics; it claims effectiveness across diverse prompts and targets while maintaining output quality.

recommendation.zh: activation steering 搬到 DiT 的工程小招，更多是可控生成工具箱补丁；知道思路即可，不必细读实现细节。
recommendation.en: A neat activation-steering port to DiT, but mostly a toolbox patch for inference-time control; worth knowing the trick, not the full details.
